articleTitle: Off-limit voltage control of high proportion photovoltaic distribution network based on active-reactive power combined regulation
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: When the distributed power supply is connected to the distribution network, the local voltage of the distribution network exceeds the boundary and the network loss increases. In this paper, an active-reactive coordinating voltage control method is proposed. Aiming at minimizing network loss and voltage deviation, the explosion generation mode, mutation rule and selection strategy of the traditional fireworks algorithm are improved, which improves the convergence speed of the algorithm and enhances the global search ability. It is used to solve the IEEE33 node system with distributed photovoltaic generations, and the performance of maintaining voltage stability and reducing power loss of the proposed method is verified.

articleTitle: PV cluster partition based coordinated voltage control for active distribution network with high penetrated PVs
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: As the penetration of photovoltaic systems (PVs) increases in active distributed networks (ANDs), the overvoltage due to reverse power flow is becoming more and more serious. Besides, methods based on traditional centralized control will not satisfy the computing time requirements of voltage control due to the dimension of control variables. This study proposes a coordinated voltage control method based on PV cluster partition for high penetrated PVs in ADNs. A community detection algorithm using reactive/active power partition quality function is introduced to divide the PVs into reactive/active power PV clusters. For the voltage control, a distributed second-order cone model is established in the reactive/active power PV clusters using the minimum amount of compensated reactive power/ curtailed active power. The proposed model in each cluster is solved by a parallel iterative optimization method, so as to achieve the purpose of coordinated control among the clusters. The proposed approach is applied to an actual feeder in China to verify the effectiveness.

articleTitle: A three-dimensional resilience index evaluation system for the distribution network under flood disaster
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Frequent flood disasters will lead to large-scale power outages in the distribution networks, and an effective resilience assessment system can help operation and maintenance personnels accurately predict and deal with distribution network failures caused by flood disasters and reduce economic loss. This paper proposes a three-dimensional resilience assessment index system, which consists of 12 individual indexes belong to state, architecture and time aspects. First, the influence of flood disaster on equipment failure rate is quantified and a mathematical model is established to reflect the relationship between rainstorm amount and failure rate. Then the fuzzy analytic hierarchy process (FAHP) and fuzzy membership function are used to comprehensively evaluate the resilience of the distribution network, and identify the weak links in the distribution network’s planning, operation and dispatching. Finally, a case study of Yubei district in Chongqing is carried out to verify the validity and rationality of the proposed resilience evaluation system.

articleTitle: An online impedance analysis device based on CloudPSS-RT and RT-lab co-simulation test bench
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: High penetration of renewable energy in power grid challenges power system operation and stability evaluation, due to the fast dynamic behaviours of power electronic devices. The accurate broadband impedance measurement is one of the critical aspects of power system stability analysis. The impedance measurement method of injecting harmonics to the actual power system may bring the risk of instability. The hardware-in-the-loop simulation technology can achieve accurate broadband impedance measurement with lower cost and risk. The computing accuracy and simulation scale of realtime simulators depend on the computing power of the target computer. As the demands of large-scale power system increase, a single real-time simulation system may not meet the requirements. Co-simulation between multiple real-time simulators is an effective way to increase the scale of the simulation. This paper proposed an online impedance analysis co-simulation framework based on the CloudPSS-RT and RT-Lab platform. The co-simulation framework was verified with A PV and DFIG power generation system.

articleTitle: Application of electro hydrogen coupling technology in the construction of new power system
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The technology of Hydrogen Energy and hydrogen electricity coupling is introduced in this paper. Hydrogen Energy is a clean, carbon-free, flexible and efficient primary energy with a wide range of applications. It is also an excellent energy storage medium and plays an increasingly important role in the energy systems of various countries. Under the "Double carbon" target, the electric-hydrogen coupling model plays an important role in constructing the new power system with the new energy as the main body. In the future, hydrogen production from new energy sources will be the main source of hydrogen energy and become an important part of the multi-source clean energy supply system. Taking the Fukushima Hydrogen Energy Research Project (FH2R) in Japan as an example, this paper analyzes the specific operation system and technical parameters of power-to-gas, and discusses the role of electric hydrogen coupling in the new power system. Under the operation mode of electric hydrogen coupling, new energy power generation is used to produce hydrogen by electrolyzing water. Hydrogen can be stored as energy for chemical synthesis, combustion and power generation. This can not only improve the flexible regulation capacity of the power system, but also facilitate the substitution of electric energy in the industrial field of high energy consumption and high emission, and finally realize the deep decarbonization of the energy consumption side.

articleTitle: Molecular dynamics simulation of impact on a high entropy alloy with void
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Molecular dynamics simulation was used to simulate the impact of high entropy alloy crystals with voids. The collapse mechanism of voids was plastic and internal jet. The microscopic collapse process of the cavity is closely related to dislocation nucleation and growth. Under the influence of lattice distortion of high entropy alloy, the main type of dislocation is Shockley dislocation, and a large number of incomplete dislocation structures with small expansion degree are generated around the void. Compared with the <110> crystal direction, the particles impacted along the <100> crystal direction are more likely to slip along the dislocation direction and void collapse when dislocation occurs.

articleTitle: Ballistic Missile Overall Parameters Optimization Based on Hybrid Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Aiming at the optimal design of ballistic missile overall parameters under a given range, a hybrid particle swarm optimization（HPSO）algorithm based on Regula-Falsi method is proposed. Firstly, the overall parameter optimization model of a ballistic missile is established, and the decoupling design of control parameters of flight program angle and propellant mass is carried out; Secondly, the Regula-Falsi method is used to quickly iterate the propellant mass, and on this basis, the particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to globally optimize the flight program angel parameters; The overall performance of the missile is optimized by alternating iterative optimization of the overall parameters. The experiments, compared with traditional optimization algorithms, show that the HPSO algorithm has the advantages of high accuracy of solution and fast convergence speed, which can meet the needs of missile overall design.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Web Information Extraction System Based on Crawler
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Web crawler technology is an important means to obtain network information. Web crawler technology faces the challenge of Web information extraction. After analyzing and studying the crawler technology at home and abroad and the scrapy framework and working principle for web information acquisition technology, this paper designs and implements a theme web crawler system for web information acquisition. According to the functional and non functional requirements of the system, the system is designed to build corresponding collection rules for different digital periodical resources, convert the web resources of digital periodicals into a node tree, and directly obtain the download URL of the required resources from the node tree of the current layout, so that the scattered resources to be obtained can be processed and reorganized in a centralized and unified manner.

articleTitle: A Real-time Co-simulation Platform for Grid-connected Distributed DFIG
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: As demands for renewable energy are promoting, the scale of wind farms increases and the distribution network structure becomes more complex. The large-scale system simulations with a high accuracy challenge traditional real-time electromagnetic transient simulation. This paper proposes a real-time co-simulation platform for grid-connected distributed DFIG based on RT-LAB and CloudPSS real-time simulators. The simulators are connected via optical fiber, and the realtime data interaction between the simulators is implemented based on Aurora protocol. A microgrid model is built in RT-LAB and a distributed DFIG model is built in CloudPSS to test the proposed co-simulation platform. The real-time cosimulation results are compared with offline simulation results, which model the whole system in MATLAB/Simulink. It demonstrates the proposed platform achieves real-time simulation with high accuracy. In addition, a hardware-in-theloop experiment is conducted and it shows that the proposed platform has the ability to interact with external controllers and can be extended to other applications.

articleTitle: Comprehensive evaluation method of relay protection based on subjective-objective combination weighting
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The evaluation of relay protection operation plays an important role in improving the level of perception of relay protection operation status. This article addresses the problems existing in the existing subjective and objective weighting methods for relay protection, that is, the subjective weighting methods cannot avoid the subjective arbitrariness of experts and the objective weighting methods cannot assess the actual importance of the project’s importance. Based on the existing subjective and objective weighting results, this method considers the statistical distribution law of the sample evaluation result sequence, and proposes a method to determine the combination weight based on the goodness of the sample evaluation result sequence to the normal distribution. The comprehensive evaluation index weight of relay protection provides support for the setting of the comprehensive evaluation index weight of relay protection.

articleTitle: A Method for Reducing Leakage Current of Static Logic Gates in 65nm CMOS Technology
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Leakage current has a significant impact on power consumption in many contemporary high-performance systems. A new method for reducing leakage current and power is proposed in this paper. The main concept is to add two P-channel Metal Oxide Semiconductors (PMOS) and two N-channel Metal Oxide Semiconductors (NMOS) on the basis of the original logic circuit. One PMOS is added between the power supply and the pull-up network, and one NMOS is added between the pull-down network and the ground. Both of them are controlled by the input signal. While the other two PMOS and NMOS are added near the output terminal and are controlled by the voltage at different nodes along the powerto- ground path. Using this method, a NOT Gate is improved into three structures and simulated by Cadence Spectre with 65nm process transistors. The proposed method can reduce power consumption by up to 68.5% at 0-1V operating voltage. The design also has a full swing output, which ensures the normal operation of the logic system.

articleTitle: Synthesis and photophysical properties of organic photovoltaic polymer donor materials based on BDT-THSEH
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The electron-donating fragment BDT-TSEH-Sn was synthesized from benzodithiophene containing thiophene sulfur side chain. The electron-absorbing fragment 2Br-TBO-DTBT was synthesized from the fragment containing benzodithiophene. Then, a polymer donor named PBDTTSEH-DTBT with a linear two-dimensional conjugated was synthesized by Still coupling reaction. A strong push-pull exists between BDT-TSEH and DTBT. The molecular weight of PBDTTSEH-DTBT was determined by GPC. PBDTTSEH-DTBT could be dissolved well in general organic solvents. The polymer donor has a wide absorption spectrum which can match well with most of the acceptors to get high-efficiency OSCs.

articleTitle: Research on the construction and security of enterprise data center based on VMware virtualization technology
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Under the background of the continuous development of information technology, the construction of enterprise data center according to the current development status of enterprises can improve the comprehensive management level of enterprises. In the process of enterprise data center construction, it is necessary to comprehensively analyze the problems existing in the traditional enterprise data center architecture based on VMware virtualization technology. Discusses the relevant factors in the process of enterprise data center construction. At the same time, VMware virtualization technology as the center, to develop a scientific and reasonable enterprise data center construction program. As far as possible to reduce the difficulty of information management in the process of enterprise data center operation and later hardware investment cost.

articleTitle: Near infrared microstructured Si-PIN photodetector with high photoresponse and low dark current
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: In this study, spike microstructures with different sizes are prepared on the surface of Silicon-based detectors via fs-laser. We then investigated the effect of the laser-textured conical microstructures on electrical characteristics of the microstuctured silicon-based photodetector. The interaction mechanism between the hyperdoping surface-layer and the conical microstructure was studied by using a finite-difference time-domain method. Furthermore, we propose a method of equivalently thickening the hyperdoping layer and remove surface defects by double-sided fs-laser-texturing combined with RIE treatment to effectively enhance the near-infrared optoelectronic properties of silicon-based detectors. The 1064nm photoresponse at 0.1 V reverse bias and the dark current at 5 V reverse bias of the novel silicon-based near-infrared photodetector fabricated by this method are 0.56 A/W and 3.6 NA, respectively.

articleTitle: Load Feature Image Identification Method Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Load identification technology which can identify types of electrical appliances through their power consumption information is the key of non-intrusive load disaggregation technology. At present, most of the commonly used load identification technologies are based on the combination of load steady-state or transient characteristics, and lack of deep information mining of feature combination. In this paper, a load feature image identification method based on convolutional neural network is proposed, which presents the combined information of load characteristics in the form of image, and we use deep convolutional neural network with residual mechanism to dig out the deep-level information of load feature image. Finally, a public dataset is used as an experimental sample to verify the method put forward in this paper. The experimental results show that the proposed method has good identification accuracy on most household appliances.

articleTitle: Study on the Compatibility between Eco-friendly Insulating Gas Mixture and Solid Materials of Used in Gas-insulated Transformers Based on Thermal Acceleration Method
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: (CF3)2CFCN-CO2 gas mixture is an eco-friendly alternative to SF6. Investigating its compatibility with solid materials used in gas transformers and promoting the application of (CF3)2CFCN-CO2 gas mixtures are of great significance for power grid companies and power systems to achieve carbon emission reduction and carbon neutrality. At present, there are few reports on the compatibility. This paper proposed the test method of the compatibility between gas mixtures and solid materials, set up the compatibility test platform and investigated the thermal stability of the 9%(CF3)2CFCN-91%CO2 gas mixture. The thermal accelerated aging test of the 9%(CF3)2CFCN-91%CO2 gas mixture and 12 kinds of solid materials at different temperatures was carried out. The results of the thermal stability test show that the initial decomposition temperature of the gas mixture in the 316L stainless steel sealed tube is 300 deg C. The initial decomposition temperature of the gas mixture in the quartz sealed tube is 400 deg C. The material of the sealed tube has a great influence on the initial decomposition temperature of the gas mixture. The results of the material compatibility test show that the 9%(CF3)2CFCN-91%CO2 gas mixture couldn’t react with 12 kinds of solid materials in the range of 40 deg C to 110 deg C. That is to say, the compatibility between the gas mixture and 12 kinds of solid materials is good in the range of 40 deg C to 110 deg C.

articleTitle: Research on Anti-biofouling Capacity of the Acrylic Resin Coating Contained Polyaniline-CuO Composite Nanoparticles
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: As human marine activities increases and marine economic industry develops, the harm and loss caused by marine biological fouling are becoming more prominent, mainly manifested in rasing CO2 emissions, affecting the safety of ships and underwater infrastructures, and hindering marine economic activities. In order to protect the marine ecological health, maintain the marine environment and reduce the impact of marine biological fouling on ship operation and marine safety, polyaniline CuO composite nano particles were synthesized by chemical method, and the toxicity of barnacle and the anti adhesion of diatom were tested in this paper. The toxicity experiment of barnacle confirmed that when the concentration of polyaniline CuO composite nanoparticles was 4 mg / L, the 24-hour mortality rate of barnacle reached 95%; The indoor hanging board experiment shows that the anti adhesion rate of polyaniline CuO composite nano acrylic coating to diatom is 89.5% after 75 days of indoor hanging board. This showed that polyaniline CuO composite nano has good anti biological fouling effect. At the same time, as an environment-friendly anti fouling agent, it has a good application prospect in anti marine biological fouling.

articleTitle: Landscape conservation design based on digital technology support
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: With the development of computer information technology, powerful digital technology is widely used in landscape conservation design. Taking digital parameterization technology as the entry point, this paper mainly analyzes the current role of digital technology on landscape conservation design, and elaborates the application and presentation of digital technology in landscape design. And how to use computer digital technology to complete the landscape conservation design scheme more precisely, humanized and efficient. A new path explored by digital technology for landscape design provides people with richer visual enjoyment effects.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Regionalization Control of Power Quality Based on Grey Relation Degree Weight Method
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The comprehensive power quality control is important in distribution network. In this paper, a comprehensive regionalization control of power quality based on grey relation degree weight method (GRDWM) was proposed. In the proposed method, the raw time series was transformed to isometric important feature sequences. With the pre-treatment, the grey relation coefficients of standardized reference sequence and standardized sequences of other nodes can be figured out by grey relational analysis (GRA). Then the grey relation degree weights of indicators of nodes can be calculated with the basic principle of weights. Combined the weight and dimensionless time series data, the comprehensive index of each node can be obtained by weighted summation method. Finally, the correlation degree for the comprehensive data among nodes can be calculated by GRA method, which is applied to figure out the regionalization results and master nodes by hierarchical clustering method. With the proposed method, the power quality in each region can be improved by the master nodes power quality control, meanwhile the power quality control device can be saved. The standard IEEE 14 bus system with harmonics and voltage deviation was utilized to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Adaptive allocation method of power system energy storage capacity under high proportion of new energy access
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Aiming at the problems that the existing power grid is increasingly affected by the output fluctuation of renewable energy, there are technical bottlenecks in promoting consumption and high peak shaving pressure, an adaptive allocation method of power system energy storage capacity under high proportion of new energy access is proposed, and a system capacity optimal allocation model considering large-scale new energy access is established. The spectrum characteristics of new energy output are analyzed, and a high proportion new energy access allocation strategy based on empirical mode decomposition is proposed. Based on this strategy. The lower level makes its day ahead power generation plan with the goal of minimizing the system operation cost. Based on the new energy and load data of a typical day of an actual power grid , the proposed model is simulated, analyzed and verified. The experimental results show that the capacity optimal allocation model of the adaptive allocation method of power system energy storage capacity under the increased proportion of new energy access can not only meet the performance requirements of power grid.

articleTitle: Study on Certification Method of GHG Emission Reduction in LNGpowered Ship Application Project
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: While consuming liquid fossil fuels, traditional oil-powered ships generate and emit a large amount of greenhouse gases (GHG) and pollutants. Supplanting it with LNG-powered ships and consuming low-carbon fuel instead of fossil fuel may effectively reduce emissions of GHG and pollutants from operating ships. Through comparatively studying and analyzing carbon emissions before and after implementation of the LNG-powered ship application project, this paper puts forth a method to calculate GHG emission reduction of the project, providing a basis for quantitative calculation for such projects to participate in trading of voluntary emission reductions.

articleTitle: Research on Full-Angle Drilling Tower Type of 110kV Single-Circuit Transmission Line
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: As the length of transmission lines increases year by year, it is more and more difficult to drill 110 kV single-circuit lines over 220 kV lines. Aiming at the problem of scheme selection for 110 kV single-circuit line drilling over 220 kV line, the restrictive factors of the drilling over scheme were analyzed, and measures such as changing the wire arrangement, 0 deg inner angle winding and 90 deg outer angle winding were adopted to carry out the drilling over Design and optimization of the tower, a single-circuit full-angle drilling tower is designed, which provides a feasible solution for 110kV single-circuit line drilling over 220kV line.

articleTitle: On Ultra-short term Demand-side Flexibility Prediction and Optimization of Control Strategy Decomposition of Cold Storage Load Aggregation
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The demand-side flexibility can promote the consumption of new energy and realize peak shaving and valley filling. As one of the demand-side loads, the cold storage load has the characteristics of randomness, large power consumption and rapid development. It is of great significance to use economic adjustment methods such as auxiliary service market to guide cold storage resources to participate in power regulation. Aiming at the cold storage loads, this paper proposes a method for predicting the adjustable capacity and optimizing the strategy for the aggregation of cold storage loads to participate in the power market. Based on the temperature model of the cold storage, the economic operation model in the environment where the cold storage load participates in the electricity market is constructed, and the method for the cold storage aggregator to declare the adjustable capacity and price to participate in the power market is given, and the optimal decomposition method for the bid-winning power of cold storage aggregators is proposed. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the method proposed in this paper are verified by simulation analysis.

articleTitle: Comparison of electromagnetic exposure for passengers at different positions on the subway platform
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: To evaluate the safety of electromagnetic exposure for passengers at different positions on the subway platform, the High Frequency Structure Simulator software is used to establish the exposure source, i.e., the leakage coaxial cable model and the adult and child passenger models. Three waiting positions (A, B and C) with an interval of 1.5 m are selected on the subway platform. The distribution of the specific absorption rate of the adult and child passengers at different waiting positions was calculated at 900 MHz. Results show that among the three locations, the maximum SAR values in the adult and child bodies appear at position A nearest to the exposure source, which are 1.5859×10(exp -7) and 1.0854×10(exp -7) W/kg, respectively. According to the comparison of the SAR distribution between the adult and the child at positions A and C, the SAR values in the child’s brain tissue are 4.98 and 2.80 times higher than those of the adult, respectively. The simulation results are well below the International Commission on Non-Ionizing Radiation Protection limits for the general public, indicating that the adult and child passengers do not suffer health risks under the electromagnetic exposure emitted by the leaky coaxial cable on the subway platform.

articleTitle: Short-term hybrid forecasting model of wind power based on EEMD-ARIMA-LSTM
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Under the dual-carbon goal, the rapid development of renewable energy and the increasing penetration of wind power pose a challenge to the safe and stable operation of the power grid. High-precision wind power prediction is essential. A large number of studies have shown that the decomposition ensemble model has good predictive ability. A hybrid prediction model based on Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition (EEMD), Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average model (ARIMA), and long short-term memory network (LSTM) is proposed to improve the prediction accuracy of wind power. The model uses EEMD to decompose the original wind power data into a series of IMF components with different bandwidths to reduce the non-stationarity and nonlinearity of the data, and uses the frequency index zerocrossing rate to reconstruct the sub-sequence into a low-frequency component and a high-frequency component. In this paper, ARIMA model and LSTM model are established to predict the high and low frequency components respectively, and the final prediction results are obtained by superimposing the prediction values of each component. By selecting wind power data from a wind farm in southwest China for simulation experiments, the results show that the EEMD-ARIMA-LSTM model has better tracking effect and prediction accuracy than other models.

articleTitle: Effect of Cold Working and Annealing Treatment on the Properties of Ti50Ni47Fe3 Memory Alloy
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: With the urgent need for a high-pressure (28 MPa) piping connection for the 4th generation fighters, the traditional hot working Ti50Ni47Fe3 alloy can no longer meet the requirements. Therefore, Ti50Ni47Fe3 alloy was subjected to different cold working deformation and annealing regimes, mechanical properties, memory recovery property tests and microstructure observation. It is shown that the microstructure is sufficiently refined with the increase in the cold working deformation amount as well as the significant increase in the mechanical property and memory recovery property of materials. The recrystallization temperature of the alloy is 600 deg C~650 deg C. The optimum annealing treatment temperature is about 450 deg C. The best memory recovery property grain orientation of the alloy is concentrated in the direction of [111].

articleTitle: Research of Container Two-dimensional Barcode technology
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: With the popularization of two-dimensional barcode applications, more and more industries use two-dimensional barcode technology to improve the efficiency of industry operations. As an important logistics transportation tool, using twodimensional barcode to improve the intelligent management level of containers has also become important option, this paper will introduce the design output and application experiment of container two-dimensional barcode, propose specific technical parameters, system architecture and operation process of using container two-dimensional barcode, and expound that container two-dimensional barcode has a good market application prospect.

articleTitle: A Novel Parameter Estimation Method for ISRJ
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: With the continuous progress of digital radio frequency memory (DRFM) technology, Interrupted sampling repeater jamming (ISRJ) has become the important research direction of electronic countermeasures (ECM). This paper proposes a novel parameter estimation method for ISRJ. Firstly, based on the pulse compression results, the parameter estimation model for ISRJ is established as nonlinear integer optimization problem. Then, to facilitate the estimation of ISRJ parameters with low complexity, the above model is converted into integer and continuous optimization models, respectively. Finally, the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) is employed to estimate the intermittent sampling paramters of ISRJ. Numerical simulations demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Optimal Control of Power System Based on Energy Storage Air Conditioning System
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: This paper proposes an optimal dispatching control strategy based on the air-conditioning load participating in the operation of the power system. Its purpose is to coordinate the optimal control of the combined cooling, heating and power system, reduce the peak-to-valley difference of the power grid, and improve the level of new energy consumption. First, based on the human thermal comfort model and air conditioning load thermodynamics, the energy storage air conditioning model is established, and the theoretical calculation formulas for its energy storage capacity, power and other indicators are derived. Secondly, the coupling relationship between system consumption, environmental pollution and system energy storage air-conditioning indicators is analyzed, and the objective function of system operation is established on this basis. Third, design a virtual energy storage control strategy for temporary peak shaving scenarios to achieve the purpose of reducing system consumption and peak shaving and valley filling. Finally, the validity and feasibility of the model are verified through experimental simulation results.

articleTitle: Research on carbon emission flow in power system based on carbon flow tracking
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The use of carbon flow tracking technology that shifts the carbon emission problem from the power generation side to the whole process of power transmission has certain practical significance. Carbon flow, a virtual network flow that exists depending on the tidal current, can measure the carbon emission intensity of the load and the carbon emission generated by the network loss on the basis of the deterministic tidal current. It provides a basis for the division of emission reduction responsibilities on the user side, and provides a reference for low-carbon power dispatching and power demand side management. Based on the principle of complex proportional sharing, a complex power flow tracking model is constructed, and the power supply ratio of each generator set in the load node and line is determined by the power flow tracking method. Then, a carbon flow tracking model is constructed based on the power flow tracking model, which incorporates the carbon flow information attached to the power flow into the entire network, and realizes the user-side carbon emission measurement.

articleTitle: Scenario planning analysis of the emerging electric battery technologies in new energy industries
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The emerging electric battery industry propels the world’s clean energy efforts, especially in the renewable energy and electrified transportation sectors. Technical innovation of electricity storage batteries focuses on four major routes, that is, LFP, ternary battery, hydrogen fuel cell and new system batteries. This manuscript analyses the prospects of these four technical routes, and applies scenario planning to forecast their market as described in the pessimistic and optimistic scenarios in near future to 2030, based on International Energy Agency (IEA) data.

articleTitle: A Bandgap Reference with Novel Piecewise Compensation Circuit
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: This paper proposes a novel CMOS bandgap reference (BGR) with the piecewise compensation circuit. The proposed compensation circuit is formed by using a current mirror, a subtraction circuit and an addition circuit to achieve a constant reference voltage and low temperature coefficient (TC) over an extensive temperature range. Design and simulation of the proposed bandgap reference was performed by SMIC.18 CMOS technology. Simulation indicated that a TC equal to 0.658 ppm/deg C obtained at a 3.3 V supply voltage and temperature range from -40 deg C to 125 deg C. The magnitude of simulated reference voltage was 1.2 V. The line regulation is 0.001019 %/V in the supply voltage range of 3.2 V - 3.4 V.

articleTitle: Coordinated Prediction Model of Microgrid Power Generation with Electric Vehicle Participation Based on LSTM and Kalman Filtering Algorithm
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: With the development of power storage technology, a huge breakthrough has been made in the ability to shave peaks and fill valleys. When the charging and discharging function of electric vehicles is introduced, with the continuous optimization of technology and algorithms, a considerable number of users will choose to use the charging and discharging characteristics to reduce the cost of daily car use. However, the flow of this power supply method is unstable. For this unstable power supply source, how to use it reasonably is a difficult problem for microgrid scheduling. In this paper, LSTM long short-term memory neural network and Kalman filter algorithm are introduced. According to the historical data of power generation provided by various power generation methods and power consumption, combined with the popularization progress of electric vehicles, a coordinated prediction model of microgrid power generation is constructed. And compared with the traditional LSTM neural network prediction model and the back-propagation neural network prediction model. The experimental results show that the prediction results of this method have good accuracy and stability.

articleTitle: An Ultra-Low-Noise Capacitive Readout Circuit for Gyroscopes
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we present an ultra-low noise readout circuit for capacitive micro-electro-mechanical system (MEMS) sensors, which is used to detect and amplify the capacitive signal of the gyroscope with an amplitude range of 0~0.2 pF and a frequency range of 5~10 kHz. The capacitance readout circuit is composed of two sub-modules, a C/V (Capacitance to Voltage) conversion circuit and a capacitively-coupled chopper gain amplifier circuit. According to the circuit characteristics of the two sub-modules, different technical means are used to achieve the overall low-noise design goal. Based on SMIC.18 CMOS process, 3.3 V power supply voltage, and 1.65 V common-mode voltage, the C/V conversion circuit can convert the capacitance signal of the gyroscope into a voltage signal and achieve good linearity fitting. To meet the optimal range requirements of the subsequent analog-to-digital converter, the voltage signal output by the C/V conversion circuit is adjusted and amplified to a preset value of 2 V through a capacitively-coupled chopper gain amplifier circuit. Finally, the output noise of the overall capacitance readout circuit is as low as 89.27 nV/√Hz@5kHZ, and the capacitance resolution also reaches the design goal of 0.1 aF.

articleTitle: Study on preparation and application of gradient polymer materials
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: As a new-style gradient materials, gradient polymer materials is paid attention to avidly due to its uniqueporoperties. In connection with present condition, preparation method and application of gradient polymer materials wereintroduced. At last, Its development trend was summaried concisely in the future.

articleTitle: Harmonic Extraction and Inverter Generation Technology of Distribution Network
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: A new type of harmonic energy separation device using parallel capacitors in series with reactance is proposed. By utilizing the voltage clamping capability of the battery pack, the harmonic energy is transported to the auxiliary power system through the inverter. By reasonably designing the parameters of the harmonic coupling circuit, most of the harmonic current of the series reactor is shunted to the harmonic absorption device, thereby eliminating the harmonics flowing through the series reactor, effectively reducing the harm of harmonics in the distribution network, and converting to the fundamental frequency energy. This paper uses PSCAD software to establish a model for verification, the simulation result shows the validity of the devices.

articleTitle: Two-Round Three-Party PAKE Protocol over Lattices
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Password-based authenticated key exchange (PAKE) enables the participants of the protocol to negotiate a secure session key on the open network only by remembering a low-entropy password. However, with the rapid development of quantum computing technology, the PAKE protocol, which is based on traditional problems such as large integer decomposition and discrete logarithm, is no longer secure. The lattice cryptosystem is a typical anti-quantum cryptography. Then with the rapid development of big data, cloud computing and supercomputers, more and more large-scale communication systems begin to appear. The existing two-party PAKE based on lattices is no longer suitable for today's large-scale communication system, and the existing single three-party PAKE based on lattices also have some problems, such as low implementation efficiency, unable to realize key exchange and so on. Therefore, by using the non-adaptive smooth projection hash function (SPHF) on the lattice, a two-round three-party PAKE protocol based on lattices with provable security is proposed. This protocol can resist quantum attacks and does not need zero knowledge proof. And the key ex-change is realized in two rounds of communication, thus reducing the number of communication rounds. Compared with other similar methods, the protocol proposed in this paper has higher execution efficiency and lower computing cost, and is more suitable for large-scale communication systems.

articleTitle: Practical Calculation Method for Reliability Assessment in Power Distribution System
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Based on the reliability evaluation theory, the basic ideas and calculation methods of reliability evaluation in the Powerfactory software are deeply analyzed. The modeling methods and calculation steps when using the software to evaluate the reliability of the distribution system are comprehensively introduced. Taking the typical single-ring network wiring in the medium-voltage distribution network as an example, the FMEA method is used to analyze the expected accidents, the power network model is built in the Powerfactory software, and the relevant calculation parameters are set for simulation analysis. A series of indicators are compared and calculated to evaluate the reliability of the distribution network wiring method.

articleTitle: Study on the Optimization of Primary Frequency Regulation for Micro-grid in Islanding Mode
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: With time, the use of distributed energy has become a new trend in the power grid. Islanded micro-grids generally consist of wind, solar, diesel and battery. In this mode, the stability in frequency is poor, requiring the generator set to reserve a portion of the primary FM backup capacity. If the microgrid is built in an area with high penetration of distributed power supply, when the frequency problem occurs, it needs PV power and wind turbine with energy storage device to operate at reduced load, and then joint frequency regulation with diesel generator, which is harmful to the environment, so its capacity should be limited. The purpose of this paper is to minimize the cost of primary frequency regulation reserve capacity of micro-grids. Frequency regulation control mode is set according to the output forecast, and the opportunity constrained planning model is established and solved with genetic particle swarm algorithm (PSO) to obtain a scheme for optimal cost of primary frequency regulation reserve and energy storage allocation

articleTitle: Power Beat Predictive Control Method of Wind Grid Connected Inverter under Harmonic and Imbalance of Power Grid
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: To improve the power dynamic response performance of wind power grid connected converter and adapt to the extreme environment of power grid, a power beat predictive control method (PBPC) of wind power grid connected converter is proposed. The discrete prediction model of wind power grid connected converter is proposed to predict the next beat switching states, and the switching state from the reference power with the smallest deviation is selected to achieve the high dynamic state of wind power grid connected converter. In view of the voltage harmonics and imbalance of the power grid, a double second-order generalized integrator is proposed to collect the positive sequence voltage fundamental frequency to control the stable operation of the wind power grid connected converter and improve its adaptability to the power grid. Under the MATLAB/Simulink, the proposed power beat predictive control method of wind power grid connected inverter is simulated, and the experimental platform of wind power grid connected inverter is built for experimental research. The results show that using this method, the power response speed of wind power grid connected inverter is fast and the overshoot is small, and it can still operate stably under the condition of grid voltage harmonic and imbalance.

articleTitle: La0.7Sr0.3FeO3-δ prepared by electrospinning as a cathode material for Proton-conducting Solid Oxide Fuel Cell
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: At present, in order to cope with the global energy crisis, it has become a general trend to adjust the energy structure and vigorously develop renewable clean energy. Efficient and environmentally friendly proton-conducting solid oxide fuel cells (H+-SOFCs) have attracted much attention due to their high proton conductivity, low activation energy and moderate temperature operation. Electrospinning is one of the effective methods to prepare nanometer fiber materials with simple device, low cost and controllable process. Porous nanoscale La0.7Sr0.3FeO3-delta (LSF) fibers were prepared by electrostatic spinning and compounded with BaZr0.1Ce0.7Y0.2O3-delta (BZCY), and then applied to H+-SOFC as composite cathode materials. X-ray diffraction (XRD) analysis showed that LSF fibers obtained pure phase after heat treatment at 900 deg C for 2h. The maximum output of the single cell was 544, 386 mW cm(exp -2) at 700 deg C and 650 deg C, respectively. Scanning electron microscope (SEM) images showed that LSF-BZCY composite cathode exhibited loose and porous microstructure and maintained a filamentous microscopic morphology, closely binding with electrolyte BZCY. To sum up, LSF-BZCY with nanofiber structure shows great advantages as the cathode material of H+-SOFC and has a good application prospect.

articleTitle: A Delta-Sigma Capacitance-to-Digital Converter for Robot Flexible Electronic Skin
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: To accurately measure the micro capacitance of capacitive tactile sensor, in this paper, a kind of capacitive sensor chip that uses second-order Sigma-Delta modulation technique to realize the direct conversion of capacitance to digital signal is introduced, and it extends measurable capacitance range by compensation capacitor matrix. To minimize the error contribution of the CDC circuitry, precision circuit technique, such as chopping, is applied circuit level. Measurement results of the capacitive sensor realized in 0.18 micrometer CMOS technology show that the CDC achieves a capacitance range from 0 to 51.5pF. The circuit achieves a resolution of 167aF at a 15pF input capacitor, and the conversion time for one measurement is 13ms, during which the CDC consumes 201.6muA from a 1.8V single supply.

articleTitle: Research on Comprehensive Benefit Analysis Model of Industrial Chain Value of Energy Internet
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The energy Internet industry has a significant meaning in the social development of the national economy and can effectively drive the high-quality development of related industries. From the perspective of the benefits generated by the energy Internet industry, the value produced by the energy Internet industry in the upstream and downstream of the industrial chain was analyzed and indexes of internal and external benefits generated by the energy Internet industry within the energy industry and society as a whole were proposed. Started with the demonstration project of each link of the energy Internet, a comprehensive evaluation framework of the value of the whole industrial chain of the energy Internet was constructed on the basis of the value flow of the whole industrial chain. The value of the whole industry consists of economic, environmental and social benefits, covering the comprehensive value of each link of the industrial chain. In the end, typical demonstration projects of the energy Internet industry were selected and quantitative analysis was made on the generated comprehensive economic and social benefits.

articleTitle: Research on Changes of Electrostatic Field Caused by Ship Motion in Deep Sea
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The electrostatic field has the characteristics of high signal strength, long propagation distance and difficult to eliminate, so it has incomparable advantages in ship positioning. By using vertical direct current electric dipole modeling, the analytical formula of the electromagnetic field generated by the electric dipole in seawater in the deep-sea model is solved according to Maxwell's equations of static electromagnetic field. Combined with the actual motion state of the ship, through Lorentz transformation, the analytical formula of the electromagnetic field generated by the motion field source is obtained, and the simulation verification shows that the ship motion has little effect on the electrostatic field, the conclusion of the same method as that of stationary ships can be used for the positioning of moving ships, which lays the foundation for the next step to study the positioning of moving ships.

articleTitle: Application research of VRay rendering technology based on 3Dmax
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: In interior design, VRay renderer is popular among the majority of users, because it uses CPU or GPU rendering acceleration to render faster, it uses unique VR material and VR lighting to render more realistic. But VRay rendering technology is more difficult to grasp. This paper will analyze the application of 3DMax renderer and VRay renderer, demonstrate their application characteristics, combined with the case of interior design renderings, with VR material, VR lights set as the breakthrough point, study from the technology based on 3dmax VRay rendering technique innovation in-depth, explore the VR technology for interior design in the aspect of design to bring new ideas and new methods.

articleTitle: Effects of oxygen ratio on pulverized coal combustion under O2/CO2 atmosphere preheated by a circulating fluidized bed
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: This study assessed the effects of oxygen ratio on preheating combustion characteristics under O2/CO2 atmosphere. The experimental results are discussed based on two aspects: the preheating characteristics and the combustion efficiency. With the increase of oxygen ratio in the primary gas, the preheating temperature increased. The reaction was more vigorously with increasing oxygen volume fractions, so the concentrations of CO, H2 and CH4 in high-temperature gas decreased and the conversion rate of each component increased. In addition, the conversion ratio of fuel-nitrogen to N2 increased as the primary oxygen ratio increased. After preheating, there were more micropores on the surface of char particles and the carbon reaction activity was enhanced. In the combustion stage, the temperature in the down-fired combustor decreased with increasing primary oxygen ratios. What’s more, increasing the oxygen ratio in the primary gas and decreasing the excess oxygen ratio could decrease NOx emissions and reduce combustion efficiency. In addition, the minimum combustion efficiency was still higher than 99%.

articleTitle: Vibration characteristics research and analysis of hydropower unit based on dynamic experiment
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The hydropower unit vibration seriously harms the safety and stability of the power station, shortens its life cycle, causes a lot of energy loss, and reduces economic benefit. Therefore, based on the 1# unit of a hydropower station, the dynamic experiment of static - starting up and grid connection - load increase - full load - load decrease - shutdown was carried out, and the vibration characteristics were analyzed, based on these, the vibration reduction strategies for the hydropower unit are given. The results show that the vibration factors are different in different transient processes, and the guide vane opening is the most important factor.

articleTitle: A deep learning method for household characteristic classification from smart meter data
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Redicting household socio-economic characteristics such as household income and cooking style from daily electricity consumption can be very useful for energy providers to offer personalized services and shift to more efficient energy management by rolling out effective energy-saving programs. In this paper, we proposed a deep learning method (CNN-LSTM) to automatically predict household characteristics from their energy consumption. The proposed CNN-LSTM model utilizes the strength of the CNN and LSTM models to learn temporal and spatial features from the time series of electricity consumption data. Our method is evaluated using the Irish Commission for Energy Regulation (CER) electricity customer behaviour trial data. The experiment demonstrates the effectiveness of deep learning-based methods, which show higher accuracy and F1-score over traditional methods such as manual feature engineering techniques.

articleTitle: Energy Efficiency Analysis of Pumped Storage Power Stations in China
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Energy efficiency reflects the energy-saving level of the Pumped Storage Power Station. In this paper, the energy flow of pumped storage power stations is analyzed firstly, and then the energy loss of each link in the energy flow is researched. In addition, a calculation method that can truly reflect the comprehensive efficiency level of the Pumped Storage power station in a certain period is put forward. At last, a Pumped Storage Power Station in China is taken as an example to illustrate the method.

articleTitle: Construction and electrochemical performance analysis of high performance graphene oxide intercalation composite zinc manganese oxide (ZnMn2O4) air electrode catalyst for potassium-oxide batteries
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Potassium-oxide batteries as promising energy storage systems have attracted more and more attention in recent years. Nevertheless, air electrode catalyst directly affects the electrochemical performances. In this paper, a type of graphene oxide intercalation composite zinc manganese oxide (ZnMn2O4) is used as air electrode catalyst for potassium-oxide batteries. Structural composition and micromorphology discover that ZnMn2O4 can composite into the graphene oxide intercalation and emerge some fluffy distribution morphology. When as air electrode catalyst for potassium-oxygen batteries, this can expose more active sites and supply more mass transmission channels for the electrochemical reaction. Electrochemical test results show that the air electrode with graphene oxide intercalation composite zinc manganese oxide as catalyst can successfully complete the oxygen reduction and oxygen evolution reaction along with excellent reversibility and low charge transfer resistance. Initial discharge specific capacity can achieve to 3078.02 mAh.g(exp -1) at 0.1 mA.cm(exp -2) current density and complete 3 time charging and discharging cycles at the condition of limited capacity to 300 mAh.g(exp -1).

articleTitle: The stability and electrical properties of alkali metal cations doped CH3NH3PbI3
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The band structure and density of states of (CH3NH3)0.75A0.25PbI3 (A=Li (exp+), Na(exp +), K(exp +)) is calculated using the ultrasoft pseudopotentials (USPs). As results shown, the tolerance factor t of the three systems close to 1, it reflects that the doped structures are stable, dopant formation energy of CH3NH3PbI3 doped with K(exp+) is -0.893 eV, which indicate that this structure is most stable. Energy band structures of the three systems doped are similar, the band gap in the range of 1.6~1.9 eV is suitable for solar cells device. With the increase of alkali metal cation radius, the band gap of corresponding structure decreases, where K(exp+) has the greatest effect on the regulation of band gap. The top of the valence band is composed of I 5p orbitals, while the bottom of the conduction band consists of Pb 6p orbitals. The divergence in stability and electrical properties are mainly due to the different CH3NH3PbI3 structures. These results can provide theoretical guidance for further in-depth research and experiments of perovskite solar cells.

articleTitle: Design and research of intelligent building central air conditioning monitoring system
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: With the development of society, buildings become increasingly intelligent, central air conditioning monitoring system is an important part of the building. The current central air conditioning monitoring system is mostly manual control, and its automation degree can’t meet the needs of the current intelligent building. At the same time, aiming at the difference of people's temperature sensitivity, the current air conditioning monitoring system cannot realize the dynamic temperature control. In this paper, an intelligent building central air conditioning monitoring system based on PLC and Fuzzy Logic is built, and the overall design scheme, software and hardware design method of the system are given. This paper proposes an automatic strategy to turn on and turn off air conditioner according to the working time and whether the room is occupied or not. An intelligent controller based on fuzzy logic theory is designed to dynamically control temperature according to different temperature sensitive groups, different time and different ambient temperatures. Through simulation experiments, the system can realize manual control, automatic control, and can control temperature intelligently and dynamically according to different thermal comfort requirements of different temperature sensitive people in different time periods and different ambient temperatures, so as to create an energy-saving, intelligent and comfortable working environment.

articleTitle: A Low-power Low-noise Capacitive Readout Circuit for Accelerometers
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: This paper presents an capacitive micro-electromechanical systems (MEMS) accelerometer readout circuit with ultralow- power (ULP). To achieve ultra-low-power characteristics, this circuit is based on self-balancing bridge (SBB) architecture that can reduce the noise requirement on amplifiers and do not require additional power consumption. Furthermore, the proposed circuit adopts a novel circuit scheme, namely, the feedforward noise reduction technique (FNRT), which removes some associated noise. Simulation results show that the designed readout circuit uses a fixed 1V supply and a common-mode voltage of 0.5V achieves 463 nW/√Hz noise levels and 152 nW power consumption.

articleTitle: A Review of SAR Images Target Recognition Based on Few-shot
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) image target recognition based on deep learning has become one of the key technologies in the field of radar detection, and the lack of SAR data sets has limited the research development of deep neural networks that rely on a large number of training samples. In this paper, we firstly introduce the SAR image data expansion methods, secondly provide an in-depth review of the current status of the migration learning-based small sample SAR target recognition methods for the small sample recognition problem, and finally, focus on some key problems that need to be solved in the field of small sample-based SAR image target recognition, and provide a long-term outlook on the development of these problems.

articleTitle: Application of Fuzzy Multiple Attribute Decision Making in Power Grid Investment Strategies
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: In order to reduce investment losses to meet the needs of power grid planning and management of energy administration, a fuzzy multiple attribute group decision making is presented to give a leading role during investment decision making. The power grid investment evaluation system is constructed. Then the weights of attribute are calculated by reciprocal judgment matrices and the attribute values are determined by a group of experts based on interval fuzzy numbers. Finally, seven projects as examples for quantitative evaluation are taken, which can efficiently prove the feasibility of the decision model.

articleTitle: Research on the Method of Improving the Collection Efficiency of Platform Curves Based on HPLC Technology
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Currently, the traditional meter reading scheme based on high-speed power line communication (HPLC) technology can only collect electric meter frozen data for 15 minutes at the fastest, which can not meet the requirements of minute level data required by the power Internet of things. To realize the minute-level real-time data acquisition, passage puts forward three improvements to the traditional scheme: Firstly, the acquisition task module is added to the application layer of the station (STA), so that the STA can store the real-time data of the electricity meter and upload it according to the acquisition task; Secondly,the communication between the concentrator and central coordinator (CCO) module is replaced by Ethernet communication, and CCO application layer transceiver sub-layer module is added to overcome the transmission speed bottleneck;Finally, the communication protocol specification from the master station to the station is united. Experimental results show that the new collect efficiency optimization scheme proposed can collect 5-minute frozen data in the field station area, and the upload time is maintained within 70 seconds. More power data can be obtained in the same period of time, which established a data foundation for the business development of ubiquitous power Internet of things.

articleTitle: Structure simulation analysis of the underwater vehicle thermal jet at discharge multiport
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The circulating cooling water of the underwater vehicle power system discharge from the discharge port, mix with the environmental water for heat exchange and form the thermal jet. The thermal jet diffuses and floats in the environmental water and forms infrared characteristics on the surface of the water. In order to explore the influence of the structure of the discharge port on the infrared characteristics of the underwater vehicle thermal jet, this paper uses the method of simulation analysis. Based on the CFD calculation software platform, the motion model of underwater vehicle is established, the number and distribution position of discharge ports are designed to compare the infrared characteristics of thermal jet, suppress the infrared characteristics of thermal jet and improve the thermal stealth performance of underwater vehicle. According to the simulation calculation results, under the condition of the same discharge flow, increasing the number of discharge ports and adopting the symmetrical arrangement of discharge ports can further strengthen the temperature attenuation of thermal jet and reduce the surface maximum temperature.

articleTitle: Analysis of Temporal and Spatial Characteristics of Transmission Line Ice-covering in Jinhua Grid Based on Distributed Full-line Optical Monitoring Data
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Icing is one of the most destructive disasters that threaten the safe and stable operation of transmission lines. This paper is to explore the differences of icing caused by the microtopography and micrometeorology along the transmission line, thus the temporal and spatial characteristics of the 220kV Ningzhu line and Xiyan line of Jinhua Power Grid in the winter of 2020-2021 are analysed based on distributed full-line optical monitoring. The results show that affected by the cold- moist desynchronization in winter and extraordinary warmth in early spring, the 220kV Ningzhu line and Xiyan line suffer slight icing, and the icing is strongly correlated with the local microtopography and micrometeorology. Among the topographical factors that are likely to cause icing, altitude and the windward slope have the greatest impact. Other topographical factors such as valley, wind channel, mountain pass, larger-scale water, and meteorological factors such as wind direction are second. The angle between the line and near-surface wind direction also exerts a strong influence on line ice-covering. The monitoring and analysis method adopted in this paper provides a new idea for the line operation and maintenance department to lay targeted ice monitoring in key sections and to carry out specific antiicing retrofit.

articleTitle: Simulation calculation and result analysis of power frequency electric field in high voltage substation
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: In order to further study the distribution of power frequency electric field in high voltage substation, taking 220kV substation as an example, based on the simplification principle of simulation modeling of high voltage electrical equipment, the simulation calculation of power frequency electric field in the station is carried out, and the distribution of power frequency electric field is studied and analyzed. The results show that the power frequency electric field intensity of 220kV substation 1.5 meters above the ground is mainly concentrated in 2-6kV/m, and the maximum electric field intensity reaches 10kV/m. The power frequency electric field has local large value near the high voltage equipment with lead down line and at the junction of overhead wire and bus outside the switch field. Finally, the simulation results are compared with the measured results, and the average error is 0.49kV/m, which meets the requirements of engineering error. It shows that the model can be used for the simulation of power frequency electric field in the substation. Finally, the simulation results are compared with the measured results, and the average error is 0.49kV/m, which meets the requirements of engineering error. It shows that the model can be used for the simulation of power frequency electric field in the substation.

articleTitle: Computational screening the potentials of TiVC MXenes monolayer as anode material for sodium-ion batteries
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The phonon spectrum, electronic structure properties and Na diffusion coefficient of the TiVC MXenes monolayer, a candidate material for SIBs, were calculated by first-principles method. Results showed that the TiVC MXenes monolayer has structural stability and presents a metallic state. In addition, the energy barrier of the Na(exp +) on TiVC surface is 2.7 meV, and that the tensile strain is conducive to Na diffusion on the TiVC MXenes monolayer. Our work show that TiVC MXenes is a potentially better anode for SIBs.

articleTitle: Research on small disturbance stability analysis method of wind power grid connected system based on Thevenin equivalent
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The external system mainly affects the small disturbance stability of the wind farm through the power flow. Through Thevenin equivalence, the external system model can be simplified without changing the impact of the external system on the power flow of the wind farm. In this paper, the external system of doubly fed wind power is simplified by Thevenin equivalence, and the wind power Thevenin equivalence model is constructed. The small disturbance stability of the model is analyzed by modal analysis method, and the small disturbance modes dominated by wind power and participated by external systems are obtained. The example shows that the above method can quickly and accurately obtain the mode of wind power leadingly participating system, which will be advantageous for the large-scale development and utilization of new energy.

articleTitle: Collaborative Planning of Distributed Photovoltaic and Energy Storage for Improving Voltage Quality
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: With the increasing penetration rate of distributed photovoltaic (DPV), reasonable DPV and distributed energy storage (DES) planning is of great significance. Aiming at the voltage problem at the present stage, in this paper, a collaborative planning model of DPV and DES is proposed. The upper level DPV planning model gives priority to minimum voltage deviation, and also takes into account the total cost and system losses of distribution network. The lower level DES planning is carried out on the basis of the results of the upper level planning. Two optimization objectives of total cost and voltage deviation are considered to complete the capacity planning of the DES and the optimization of charge and discharge strategy. The particle swarm optimization is used to solve the problem. Simulation results verify the effectiveness and rationality of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Modeling and Fuzzy Control Study on Hybrid Energy Storage System for Pure Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Power capability is the core technology of electric vehicles. To solve the low power density problems, poor high-current charging and discharging capacity and short cycle life of the current pure electric vehicle power battery, the hybrid energy storage system composed of supercapacitor and power battery is used as the research object to determine the structure of composite energy storage system composed of the battery and supercapacitor. The power requirements are analysed for the battery and supercapacitors of the drive motor in different operating states. And then the corresponding fuzzy control policy is devised for the power distribution of the composite energy storage system according to the required power of the vehicles, the SOC of the battery and the supercapacitor. Then electric vehicles model is established by using composite energy storage system on account of fuzzy control in ADVISOR and Simulink. By analysing the simulation results, it is shown that the hybrid energy storage system and its control strategy can simultaneously satisfy the dual requirements of pure electric vehicles for energy and power, and the economy and power of the vehicle can be improved. In comparison with single supply battery power, the pure electric vehicle motor drive system with hybrid energy storage system is more efficient, and the continuous mileage, maximum speed, minimum acceleration time and maximum gradeability for 50Km/h are improved on a single charge. The continued mileage is greatly increased by 32.47%, while avoiding the high current charging and discharging of the battery, and prolonging the battery service life.

articleTitle: Detection of metallic turn-turn short circuit of dry air core reactor based on digital twin current method
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: For the sake of obtaining current distribution characteristics of dry-type air-core reactor under normal functioning and turn-to-turn short circuit fault, the equivalent circuit of the turn to turn insulation fault is established, and the calculation formula of the equivalent impedance and current under voltage source or current source are given. The equivalent circuit and coil parameters of dry-type air-core reactor excited by voltage source are simulated by finite element method; The equivalent circuit and coil parameters of dry-type air-core reactor excited by current source are calculated analytically and verified by experiments. The feature: with the change of reactor excitation mode, dry-type air-core reactor presents different current distribution characteristics is showed by the results; With the change of the position of the short circuit turn, different distribution characteristics are presented by the current in each layer of the dry-type air-core reactor, and certain distribution characteristics with the change of the position of the short circuit turn are presented by the current in the same layer. Based on this, a method for monitoring and locating the inter turn short circuit fault of the dry-type air core reactor under multiple-harmonic excitation is proposed. It is suggested to select current as the monitoring parameter of turn-to-turn insulation of dry-type air-core reactor, the results can be used in the digital twin technology of power equipment monitoring, which is of great significance to realize the intelligence of power equipment condition evaluation.

articleTitle: Oscillation Characteristic Analysis and Wind-Storage Control of Wind Farms with Energy Storage Participating in Primary Frequency Regulation
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The increase of wind power permeability weakens the inertia level of the system and brings great challenges to frequency stability. The frequency stability of the system can be improved by combining energy storage and fans to participate in the primary frequency modulation of the power grid. The current research is mainly focused on the influence of different parameters on the oscillation characteristics of wind power grid-connected system under only wind turbine grid-connected, without considering the changes of system stability under the participation of wind turbine itself in frequency regulation and energy storage system access. Therefore, this paper analyses the influence of different parameters on the oscillation characteristics of the AC outgoing system of the wind farm with energy storage participating in primary frequency regulation, and designs two control methods, wind-storage independent frequency regulation and wind-storage coordinated frequency regulation, and compare and analyse the influence of the two control methods on the system stability.
