The results show that the proposed method can effectively improve the frequency stability of the system, and the effect is better when the wind-storage coordinated frequency regulation control is adopted.

articleTitle: Local Voltage Control of Distribution Network Based on PV Inverter Reactive Capacity
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Aiming at the problem of increased network loss and over-limit voltage caused by a large number of distributed photovoltaic generations connected to the distribution network, a local voltage control method based on the PV inverter reactive capacity was proposed. In order to minimize the system network loss and photovoltaic light discarding, a reactive power optimization model of distribution network was established considering the voltage constraints and the capacity constraints of inverter, and solved by particle swarm optimization algorithm. In this strategy, the active and reactive power output of the inverter is adjusted, and the traditional voltage regulation methods such as OLTC and capacitor banks are used to ensure that the node voltage of the system is within the specified range. The local voltage control of the distribution network under the distributed photovoltaic access is realized. Finally, the correctness and feasibility of the proposed method are verified by an example of improved IEEE33 node distribution system.

articleTitle: Three-Phase Power Flow Algorithm for Distribution Network using a Standardized Matrix Form
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: With continuous expansion of renewable energy installation scale, it is increasingly necessary to carry out power quality analysis on distribution network. The traditional power flow method for distribution network is mainly based on the back-forward sweep algorithm. When three-phase unbalance problems are considered, the complexity of algorithm increases sharply. Additionally, the convergence of power flow can not be guaranteed when control strategy of renewable energy sources changes. In order to solve this problems, the paper proposes a three-phase power flow algorithm for distribution network. It can take power quality into consideration and can be used to calculate power flow of various grid structures. The framework of algorithm in the paper uses matrix operations such as inner product, index matrix and incidence matrix to generate three-phase admittance matrix and corresponding matrix of three-phase power flow with Newton-Raphson method. The paper uses OpenDSS to verify the accuracy of the method on IEEE33 test case.

articleTitle: The Importance of Insulation Measures to Avoid Outlet Short Circuit Fault for Power Transformer
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The short-circuit current at the outlet of the transformer is relatively large, which will cause certain mechanical and thermal damage to the body. Due to the cumulative effect, several times of outlet short-circuit fault may cause internal faults of the transformer. Therefore, insulation measures are often used to strengthen the protection of the transformer and avoid outlet short-circuit fault. This paper illustrates the importance of correct insulation measures with two cases, and puts forward several targeted suggestions to improve the quality of equipment maintenance. Keywords-transformer; short-circuit fault; insulation measures

articleTitle: Research on Operation Mechanism, Information Collection and Compliance Model of Hydropower Monitoring System
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: According to the current situation of control system of hydropower plant, the method of establishing compliance model can effectively prevent misoperation, malicious operation, network attack and virus of Control System.In order to simulate the unit operation in the process of non-compliance, such as the operation of the wrong behaviour, as well as malicious operation, and so on.The purpose of taking the control process of a hydropower plant as an example is to find a real-time monitoring and alarm method for the internal equipment fault, control flow fault and operation, operation, misoperation in the control process, malicious operation and other dangerous factors which may seriously threaten the safety of the whole control system and the power production safety of the power plant, in order to alert relevant staff according to the specific production situation to take timely effective preventive measures. Further carry out the fragility research of the electric power monitoring system of large hydropower plants, construct the operation behavior and compliance model of the hydropower plant monitoring system, develop a prototype of the behavioral compliance detection device, and deploy it in the simulation environment of the hydropower plant for effectiveness verification. The construction of power plant network security defense system and the formation of defense capabilities provide important support.

articleTitle: Research and Realization of Flexible Piezoelectric Sensors based on MoS2 Nanosheets-Films
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Comfortability and biocompatibility (BC) of smart wearable devices are the high-profile indexes in recent years. Molybdenum Disulfide (MoS2), one of typical Transition-metal Dichalcogenides (TMDCs), is proved with piezoelectric property in the form of 2D few- or single-layer nanosheets. Based on this prosperous property, firstly the preparation process of MoS2 nano-sheet film was improved to obtain changeable flexibility based on former research; after that, a novel cross-channel inner structure of flexible sensor shell was proposed and realized via 3D printing technology. With the proposed one-shot design, the cascade of piezoelectric channels was realized to obtain wider frequency band. Besides, the filling process of flexible piezoelectric material into the designed shell was proposed and realized as well. After experiments, the prepared sensor is proved with excellent flexibility, with a tensile strength up to 9MPa, and Shore hardness up to 30 deg C. The excellent strength and limpness allow the designed sensor to be embedded into flexible instrument and daily wearable devices, such as smart insoles for medical diagnosis purpose.

articleTitle: A New Topology of Hybrid DC Circuit Breaker with Current Limiting Capability
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: DC circuit breakers and fault current limiters are important devices in DC power grids. They have similar structures and therefore have the conditions for integration. However, most of the existing DC circuit breakers with current limiting capability have complex structures and control strategies. In this regard, this paper proposes a new topology of hybrid DC circuit breaker with current limiting capability, which has simple topology and control strategy. After a fault occurs, the inductor can be inserted for fault current limiting, and the current limiting effect is significant. In addition, the proposed circuit breaker can automatically adjust the working status according to the protection judgment result. This paper first introduces its topology and working principle, then conducts theoretical derivation, and finally performs simulation verification in PSCAD/EMTDC. The simulation results show that the proposed circuit breaker shows good applicability in the DC grid.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Forecasting for photovoltaic power generation based on Bayes Ridge regression
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: With the large-scale integration of new energy sources such as photovoltaics, the uncertainty of their output has brought more significant challenges to the safe and stable operation of the power system. Therefore, this paper proposes a photovoltaic prediction method based on Bayesian ridge regression (BRR) to solve this problem. This method can achieve the prediction of photovoltaic output through probabilistic analysis. At the same time, it provides data support for power system optimal dispatch based on uncertainty modeling.

articleTitle: Over-voltage Analysis of High Penetration PV Integration to Distribution Network Considering Whole-County-PV Development
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The whole county photovoltaic (PV) development will have an impact on the voltage level of the distribution network due to high penetration of PVs. Firstly, the mechanism of distributed PV to raise voltage level is explored. Then, based on Monte Carlo simulation, the analysis method of the influence of PV configuration uncertainty on voltage is proposed. Finally, the back/forward power flow calculation is adopted, taking a 10kV 88-node feeder in Jiangsu as an example. The voltage level under the current condition, the voltage level after adding planned PV capacity and the maximum PV hosting capacity are calculated and analyzed, which provides reference for the promotion of whole-county-PV development in China.

articleTitle: Research on Abnormal Energy Consumption Monitoring Model Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Energy consumption monitoring is an important link in energy management. It aims to find abnormal energy consumption and find the cause of the abnormality to solve it, thereby reducing energy waste. The traditional energy consumption abnormal monitoring method mainly uses the threshold comparison method. This method is simple and easy to use, but lacks self-adaptive ability and is prone to missed detection or false detection. Therefore, this paper uses the BP neural network prediction method to analyse the application scenarios of abnormal energy consumption monitoring, builds an abnormal energy consumption monitoring model based on the BP neural network, obtains the energy consumption prediction interval under normal conditions, dynamically sets the alarm baseline, and reduces the missed or false detections.

articleTitle: Frequency Regulation Control System of Wind Power Participating in Power Grid Based on DFIG
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: As one of the most common renewable energy sources, wind energy has the advantages of abundant resources, inexhaustible resources and convenient use, making it a renewable resource with the best development prospects. With the penetration of large-scale wind energy into the power system, the strong randomness and interruption of power generation are bound to negatively affect the frequency response of the grid. Doubly-fed induction generators (DFIG) generally outperform modern permanent magnet generators in terms of operating efficiency, and are therefore the most basic type of wind turbine today. In this paper, based on the research of DFIG's wind power participating in the gridconnected system of the power grid (PG), three frequency regulation (FR) control strategies of DFIG are proposed, and three control strategies (CS) are used to control the system frequency. The two frequency deviation fluctuations of overproduction and de-loading operation are opposite, and both frequency deviations are reduced under the inertial emulation control.

articleTitle: Automatic classification method for new energy patents based on improved DPCNN
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Patent text has very important research value, and the traditional patent classification method is generally based on the IPC classification standard. the IPC classification standard is relatively coarse, and with the rapid growth of the number of patents, the standard can no longer meet the real situation, and a patent classification method is urgently needed to help various industries achieve accurate classification of patents. To this end, this paper proposes an improved patent classification model of DPCNN. First, a Concat layer is added to DPCNN to fuse the features of each layer of the network and improve the problem that traditional neural networks tend to lose structural information. Then, a label smoothing strategy is introduced to avoid overconfidence of the neural network in training answers during the training process. Finally, the effectiveness of the model is verified by taking a new energy patent as an example.

articleTitle: Smooth switching control of microgrid based on droop control
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: As the energy crisis becomes more and more serious, the world pays more and more attention to the new energy, so distributed generator (DG) will be the research hotspot and development focus in the future. The microgrid technology effectively solves the influence of distributed power supply on the large power grid. Microgrid supports grid-connected operation and isolated operation. In grid-connected operation, distributed power supply can be fully used to generate electric energy, while in isolated operation; an independent small power grid system can be rapidly formed to provide continuous and reliable power supply. Based on the study of droop control, this paper proposes a microgrid smooth switching control based on droop control. When the microgrid runs in island mode, the power balance can be carried out quickly to realize the smooth switching of the microgrid, and the voltage and frequency inside the microgrid can meet the operation requirements, so that the local load can continue to use electricity reliably. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed control strategy are verified by matlab/simulink simulation.

articleTitle: Visual data acquisition method of intelligent power supply system under different power supply scenarios
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: In order to improve the data visualization collection capability of the power supply system under different power supply scenarios, a method for data visualization of the smart power supply system for different power supply scenarios based on dynamic sensor data collection and the support of video hardware equipment is proposed. The equipment tree model of data visual acquisition of intelligent protection power supply system is established, and combined with video stream display, the data visual terminal transmission and video synchronous display of intelligent protection power supply system are realized. The dynamic sensor node distribution model of data output under different power supply scenarios is established, and the visual control of intelligent power supply output under different power supply scenarios is realized through dynamic sensor fusion, tracking and identification. Obtain data from different power supply scenarios on the Internet of Things platform, use association rule mining and spectral feature analysis, dynamically load and integrate and control the data of the smart power supply system. Use the Spring framework to build the visual distribution layer of the data acquisition system, receive user requests through the Controller, and realize the visual data collection of the smart power supply system. The test results show that the data visualization collection output using this method has high stability, and the scene adaptability and stability of the data output are good.

articleTitle: Research on Power Balance Control Strategy of Island AC/DC Hybrid Microgrid
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: In order to realize power balance in AC/DC hybrid microgrid island mode and make full use of distributed energy, this paper proposes a control strategy combining model prediction algorithm with bidirectional droop control for the control of bidirectional AC/DC converters to achieve fast and accurate power transmission between two subnets. The simulation results show that under the condition of AC/DC side of various power fluctuations, The control strategy can realize bidirectional power flow between subnets quickly and accurately, guarantee the power balance of the system, ensure the stability of the system voltage and frequency, reduce the steady state error of the system and realize the stable operation of hybrid microgrid.

articleTitle: Earth Fault Detection Method in Non-solidly Earthed Network Based on the Increments of Phase Current
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: In current distribution network, transient features of current and voltage are widely used to solve earth fault as ground system varies and makes it is very important to find its precise fault point when an earth fault occurs. Zero-sequence current and voltage are required to acquire in most method, which is not suitable for old distribution line. This thesis comes up with a method which uses abrupt current change to trigger its logic, determine fault point according to Bhattacharyya Distance and calculate unbalance ratio via the fault point and complete the whole procedure. This method is very precise and robust according to simulation analysis and real-time experiment results.

articleTitle: Analysis of important processes of ultra high voltage alternating current project progress control based on WBS architecture decomposition
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Under the new situation, the construction progress control of the project is affected by the external conditions of regional characteristics, policy environment, natural conditions, construction team capacity, and in the super-scale projects of UHV, the status of progress management is more important. This paper introduces the WBS architecture into the progress management of the UHV project, uses the correlation analysis method to construct the construction period and total duration of the main process, and identifies the important processes combined with the analysis results. It can carry on key management for important processes, put forward targeted progress control plans, and comprehensively improve the level of project construction progress control and the ability to optimize resource allocation.

articleTitle: Intelligent Substation IOT System design based on edge computing
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The smart substation accesses a large number of sensor devices to sense the parameters of the substation equipment, and the current substation IOT system mainly calculates and processes the accessed sensor data in the data center, resulting in high computational pressure on the data center side and low bearing capacity of the IOT system. To address the above problems, the intelligent substation IOT system based on edge computing is designed. The hardware architecture of the IOT system is designed in the form of PMB7900 plus microcontroller dual core. Under the hardware support, the substation IOT edge computing system is designed to achieve flexible access to the IOT system by processing the state sensing of substation sensing devices during their life cycle and realizing multiple sensors. The system performance test results show that the designed system has good carrying capacity and the system processing time is shortened by about 63.2%, which is a significant performance improvement compared with other systems.

articleTitle: The Analysis for Active Power Loss of Capacitor Voltage Transformer
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Capacitor voltage transformer (CVT) is the most widely used type of voltage transformer in Shandong power grid. With the continuous expansion of power grid scale, higher requirements are put forward for the insulation performance and operation stability of CVT. At present, the dielectric loss tandelta is generally recognized as an important characteristic parameter to characterize the overall insulation status of CVT, but this traditional detection and evaluation method can not effectively evaluate the insulation status of CVT. To solve this problem, a CVT insulation state evaluation method based on active power loss is proposed in this paper, and the effectiveness of this method is verified by two examples. And this method can be used as a powerful complement to the conventional insulation detection parameter tandelta.

articleTitle: Homology recognition of multi voltage sag events based on perceptual hash sequence
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: At present, in the power grid, a single voltage sag event will be recorded by different monitoring terminals. Due to the needs of voltage sag location, propagation law and regional power grid sag evaluation, it is necessary to merge the voltage sag events in a certain period of time. Therefore, a multi voltage sag event homology recognition method based on perceptual hash sequence similarity is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the sampling rate of the recorded data is unified, and the number and time of abrupt changes are detected by S-transform; secondly, according to the recording situation and sudden change time, the sag data segment is extracted, and all possible waveforms of the reference data are obtained by using the transformer transfer matrix; then, the gram angle field is used to convert the one-dimensional data of voltage sag into two-dimensional images, and the perceptual hash algorithm is used to convert it into hash sequences. The similarity between sequences is compared by Euclidean distance to realize the homologous identification of voltage sag events. Finally, the simulation data generated by IEEE30 bus system are used to verify the accuracy and practicability of this method.

articleTitle: Experimental research of carbon flooding and buried in buried hill reservoirs with high-angel
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The human living environment had become fragile due to "greenhouse effect", the effect was mainly caused by carbon emissions. Countries were committed to changing this situation. China had also proposed the target of "carbon neutrality and peak". Oil production was one of the main sources of greenhouse gas. While reducing emissions, it was necessary to make full use of exhaust gases to help oil extraction, to realize utilization and sequestration. For verifying that CO2 could effectively store while displacing, lab experiments was utilized to carry out CO2 injection gravity flooding and sequestration with the help of the unique geological structure in high-angle buried hill Z reservoir. It shown that stable miscible displacement can be achieved, the volume of oil expanded by 98.2% and viscosity decreased by 75% after CO2 injection. Permeability and seep ability of formation was improved by the action of CO2 in corrosion, due to the difference densities, CO2 would formed a stable gas cap at the top, oil was continuously displaced downward to form gas gravity flooding, and the ultimate recovery factor can be increased by 12.9 %, 92.5 % of the CO2 was buried.

articleTitle: Research on the optimization and regulation technology of integrated energy system based on energy storage air conditioning system
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: This paper models a comprehensive energy system serving the overall planning of production and living load around including energy flow, heat, cold and natural gas and combining the energy storage characteristics of energy storage air conditioning system. The model comprehensively considers the energy storage characteristics of energy storage air conditioning system and its impact on economic benefits, quantifies the energy storage capacity, and studies the comprehensive energy system. Using the comprehensive energy system simulation model and historical operating data established by the Apros platform, the coefficient was modified and the system equipment parameters were improved. The validation results show that the key parameters of the model are controlled within normal, proving the model and correction parameters correctness and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Test and Calculation Methods of the Global Warming Potential for eco-friendly insulating mediums
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Global warming is a huge challenge for the survival of humanity. SF6 as a super greenhouse gas is facing the end of being eliminated. (CF3)2CFCN and C5F10O as the substitute for SF6, the evaluation of the impact on climate change depends on the calculation of GWP. In this work, we introduced and summaried the calculation and testing principles of GWP. Further, the radiative efficiencies of (CF3)2CFCN and C5F10O were calculated by using the revised Pinnock curve based on the Oslo line-byline (LBL) model and density functional theory. Finally, we calculated the the global warming potential of (CF3)2CFCN and C5F10O based on the experimental values of the atmospheric lifetime and radiative efficiencies. The results show that the contribution of (CF3)2CFCN to climate change is significantly lower than that of SF6.

articleTitle: GIS Partial Discharge Pattern Recognition Based on Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: In the power grid, GIS (gas-insulated substation) has become one of the important equipment. Correct identification of GIS partial discharge defect types can prevent the defects from continuing to cause harm to the point of failure. In this paper, insulation defects which cause the partial discharge in GIS could be divided into three categories: metal particles on the surface, free metal particles inside and metal protrusions on the surface. The waveforms of partial discharges in GIS under 60 kV were measured in these three cases by ultrasonic detection method. Each type recorded 100 groups of data. Then, the six parameters were extracted as the characteristic quantities of partial discharge patterns based on the waveforms. Finally, the data were imported into the random forest algorithm to build and train a GIS partial discharge pattern recognition model. To test the accuracy of the model, 30 sets of data were reserved as a test set to be brought into the model for recognition, and the accuracy of the GIS partial discharge pattern recognition model was found to be 96.7%. Therefore, the accuracy of GIS partial discharge defect type identification with random forest algorithm is high, and the research content in this paper is useful for reducing GIS faults.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on Offshore Flexible Low Frequency Transmission M3C Converter Station
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: In an offshore flexible low-frequency power transmission system based on a modular multilevel matrix converter (M3C), ensuring that the module capacitor voltage follows a given value is a prerequisite for the stable operation of the system. In order to study the capacitor voltage control strategy, this paper first established the M3C mathematical model based on double alphabeta transformation, and designed the input and output dq transformation vector controllers and circulating current controllers, and then analyzed the power of the M3C bridge arm. For the frequency characteristics of the bridge arm power, the notch filter is used to separate the AC uncontrollable quantity and the DC controllable quantity, so as to obtain the expected value of the circulating current to control the circulating current. Finally, a model of the M3C converter station based on the nearest level approximation modulation is built for simulation verification. The simulation results verify the frequency characteristics of the bridge arm power, and the proposed control strategy controls the capacitor voltage within ±10% of the average value.

articleTitle: Influence of Different Recursive Least Square Algorithms on Online Parameter Identification of Li-ion Batteries
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The accuracy of the lithium battery equivalent circuit model is of great significance to the management of lithium-ion batteries. Second-order Thevenin equivalent circuits is a commonly used for lithium-ion battery equivalent circuits due to the accuracy and computational effort taken into account. The parameters of the equivalent circuit model are influenced by various factors and their values will change with time during operation. Therefore, the recursive least square (RLS) method is used to identify the model parameters to obtain the time-varying parameters. However, the RLS algorithm suffers from "data saturation phenomenon", so this paper combines the RLS algorithm with rectangular window and exponential window, and adds the damping term to the RLS algorithm. It is experimentally verified that the RLS algorithm combining rectangular and exponential windows can improve the identification accuracy of equivalent circuit parameters.

articleTitle: Research on the Design of National and Reinforced Loongson 3A4000 Computer
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the computer processing performance of industrial scenes is low and the national production of software and hardware is not realized, a 6U reinforced computer module solution based on Loongson3A4000 processor and JARI-Works embedded operating system is proposed in this paper. The module adopts CPEX bus architecture and is matched with 7A1000 bridge chip of Loongson company. The interfaces provided include serial port RS232, Ethernet, USB, SATA, PS/2, CPEX bus interface and other common interfaces, as well as can bus interface commonly used in industrial field; In order to meet the demand of high-definition display, JM7200 graphics card chip of JingJiaWei is externally connected to PCIe bus interface to realize independent display, and supports 4-channel HDMI interface with resolution up to 4K; Kunlun firmware is used as the boot program of computer module. The heat dissipation structure uses the steam chamber temperature equalizing plate to improve the heat conduction efficiency.

articleTitle: Short-term power load forecasting based on BP neural network
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: In order to improve the stability of grid load forecasting. Aiming at short-term microgrid load forecasting, this paper proposes a method based on BP neural network to forecast the source side of the power grid. This method is based on the user’s historical electricity consumption data. Through the training sample data, the influence of various influencing factors on the electricity load of the microgrid is analyzed, and the load forecasting model is established through the BP neural network topology, and then the short-term electricity is simulated by MATLAB. Load forecasting, for a 24-hour a day power load forecasting of a microgrid, the forecast result shows that it is consistent with the actual value, which proves the stability of the model.

articleTitle: Methodology for Assessing a Nuclear Power Plant Environmental Integrated Effect within Sino-Russian Energy Cooperation Development
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: This paper is based on the establishment of comprehensive indicators, embedded in the formed fuzzy-multiple models to assess the environmental impact of nuclear power plants and propose measures for minimizing this effect.

articleTitle: Optimal Configuration Strategy of Regional Multiple Energy System Considering the Low-carbon Operation
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Regional multiple energy system plays an important role in improving system reliability and energy efficiency, due to its safe, clean, and sustainable characteristics. The performance of regional multiple energy system relys on its configuration and various facts should be considered during the configuration optimization. As the pressure of climate changes, the low-carbon operation is one of the critical goals, which should be included in the configuration optimization process. In this paper, the optimal configuration of regional multiple energy system considering the lowcarbon operation has been investigated. A simulation and planning implementation framework for multiple energy system is established. The framework consists of topological modeling, measuring system, and simulation. The carbon emission cost model has been developed based on the system carbon flow model and carbon trading mechanism. The optimal configuration platform is built for regional multiple energy system. The proposed framework is implemented on the CloudPSS platform and tested with the IEEE-33 bus system. The test results show that the voltage quality and energy efficiency have been improved by system optimal configuration which can guide the construction of regional multiple energy system.

articleTitle: Functional Adaptability Test and Analysis of High-speed Broadband Power Line Communication Module
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Broadband power line carrier technology is widely used in the communication network of power grid information acquisition systems. The development of power line carrier communication technology is introduced, and the orthogonal frequency division multiplexing modulation method is briefly described. The necessity and importance of functional adaptability test of high-speed broadband power line carrier module are analyzed in this paper. It is proposed that the functional adaptability test of the carrier module mainly includes concurrent meter reading, transparent forwarding communication, and identification of station area. At the same time, a simple and reliable test method is designed according to various functional test contents. In terms of the average time consumption of HPLC module meter reading, single-chip concurrent meter reading takes the slowest time, and the success rate is 100%. The single-chip transparent forwarding communication test success rate is also 100%. The station recognition test results show that more than 90% of the manufacturers’ products can correctly identify the abnormal files in the station area, but the time-consuming is not the same. The test results in this paper are of great significance to the evaluation and selection of related high-speed broadband power line carrier modules and the improvement and perfection of associated products.

articleTitle: Research and application of grating passive conveyor integrated protection system
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: As essential equipment in the conveying process, the safety and stability of the belt conveyor are of great significance to the efficient and safe operation of the conveying process. If the enterprise improves transportation efficiency, without considering the safe operation of the belt conveyor, it will cause hidden dangers to personal safety and property safety. Therefore, the design and application of the belt conveyor integrated protection device is crucial to the safety of workers and equipment. For the integrated protection system of belt conveyor, a new grating passive conveyor integrated protection system is designed to reduce the faults caused by electromagnetic interference, improve the reliability and utilization rate of the protection system, and reduce the construction and operation costs.

articleTitle: Energy storage system planning method for improving photovoltaic hosting capacity in cyber-physical system
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Energy storage system (ESS) is an effective way of voltage regulation, its reasonable configuration is significant for photovoltaic (PV) hosting capacity improvement. In addition, the degree of coupling of cyber-physical system (CPS) is increasing so that its effect should be considered in planning. For this reason, a two-layer collaborative planning model of ESS and its communication network (CN) considering CPS coupling effect is proposed to solve voltage over-limit problem, with regarding economy, robustness, etc. as objects. The improved NSGA-II and BPSO are used for case study, and the results show that the method realizes the ESS collaborative planning considering the coupling effect of CPS. The schemes obtained have better economic benefits and control performance, so that have obviously practical guiding significance.

articleTitle: Design of a flexible gripper based on composite structure
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Based on the requirements of dexterity and flexibility of robots’ end actuators in the future, a pneumatic flexible gripper with composite structure is proposed in this paper. According to the demand of two degrees of freedom in space, a flexible gripper with joint-grip composite structure is designed. The flexible gripper is driven by air pressure and controlled by several air valves. According to the characteristics of the flexible gripper, the driving system and control system are designed. The main material of the flexible gripper is silica gel. Due to the particularity of the mechanical structure of the flexible gripper proposed in this paper, the traditional manufacturing method of injection molding is improved. Finally, the pneumatic flexible gripper of the composite structure is installed on a three-stage manipulator, and its structure and performance are analyzed through a series of experiments.

articleTitle: Introduction to FinFET: Formation process, Strengths, and Future Exploration
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The paper introduces the formation, development, and future exploration of FinFET. It introduces the invention history, the formation and working principle of conventional bulk FinFET with three gates. The current technological level of FinFET is also subsequently shown with TBG JL FinFET. In the next section, by calculating the relational equation of mobility and impurity concentration and observing the gate voltage change data, the paper compares FinFET with MOSFET in three aspects to demonstrate the advantages of FinFET: carrier mobility, short channel effect, and subthreshold leakage current, and chip area. After discussing the advantages of FinFET, challenges in its development will be described, i.e., corner effect (fin shape), parasitic capacitance and resistance, and fin patterning. In the future, one possible exploration to maximize the potential of FinFET is to promote the development and application of GAAFETs based on FinFETs technology.

articleTitle: Study on key modules of high voltage integrated acquisition terminal and applications
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: An intelligent type of acquisition terminals of high voltage was introduced, and the suspended power source and filtering circuit were designed to accommodate the steady power supply on high voltage site. The improved arithmetic was applied to solve the problem of electric energy measuring on periodicity aberrance wave. A new unimpeachable charge management system was proposed based on high voltage and low voltage parameters assisted mutually. Besides the automatic long-range meter reading, electricity purchasing management and the charge management, the system could conform to the electricity filcher, faulty measuring installations and the quantity of lost electrical energy. The availability of the terminals and the new charge management system is proved by the practical trial.

articleTitle: Design of Supercapacitor Auxiliary Circuit for Substation Parallel DC Power Supply System
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: At present, the application of a parallel DC power supply system in a high-voltage substation is still in its infancy. There is no specific design technical specification for its reliability under short-circuit fault, calculation and configuration scheme of relevant circuits, which is not conducive to the design of substation. This paper compares and analyzes the power supply modules and the design techniques for overload continuous current and supercapacitor short-circuit compensation auxiliary circuits of substation present parallel DC power supply system, and selects the superior 4A power supply module and supercapacitor to design and research the auxiliary circuit of parallel DC power supply sys-tem. Based on the examples of substation projects, the equivalent model of the power supply system and the calcula-tion method of supercapacitor parameters are proposed, the protection discrimination of the DC circuit breaker is cal-culated and verified, and the rationality and effectiveness of the proposed method are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Surface Water-Groundwater Distribution in Southern Irrigation Area of Qinglongshan Irrigation District
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The efficient water distribution in an irrigation district that serves as a major agricultural infrastructure plays an important role in improving food production capacity. The unreasonable ratio of surface water use to groundwater use leads to a significant drop in the groundwater level of the northern irrigation district. Saint-Venant equations in network form have been adopted in this paper to predict the water movement process in the canal irrigation system. The ratios of surface water and groundwater use of every irrigation units for different growth stages during different target years have been studied by using the objective of maximizing the efficiency of surface water utilization, in the southern irrigation area of Qinglongshan irrigation district. Thereby providing technical support for the efficient distribution of water resources in the southern irrigation area of Qinglongshan irrigation district

articleTitle: Analysis on the Methodology for Reducing the Power Consumption of CMOS in VLSI
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: In the past few years, people's pursuit of performance has led to a sharp increase in power consumption in VLSI. For this reason, researchers have proposed many methods to reduce power consumption. Based on this phenomenon, this article aims to provide reference for later researchers by exploring popular ways to reduce power consumption. In this paper, the author introduces the source of power consumption, as well as summarizes traditional and novel ways to reduce power consumption. Through this research, the author found that all of the introduced methods, whether traditional methods or novel methods, have been proven to effectively reduce power consumption.

articleTitle: Application of SPWM Bidirectional Converter Technology in Emergency Power Supply
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzes the design points of the overall content of emergency power supply, The content includes the working principle, bidirectional DC / DC circuit, SPWM inverter, etc, Combined with the specific process of SPWM bidirectional converter technology in emergency power supply, the contents include A/D sampling, judging working state, discharging module management, charging module management, etc. By studying the converter control strategy, grid-connected operation control strategy, island operation control strategy, midpoint potential balance control strategy, it is also demonstrated in an experimental way, the aim is to improve the cognitive level of SPWM bidirectional, Ensure the operating stability of the emergency power supply.

articleTitle: Investigation on mechanical properties and low cycle fatigue behaviors of AZ31 magnesium alloy after ECAP treatment
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Tensile and compression test were carried out on wrought AZ31 magnesium alloy. The experimental results indicates that there is strong tension-compression yield asymmetry in wrought AZ31 alloy due to difference deformation mode under tensile and compression load. After one pass ECAP treatment, tension-compression yield asymmetry of AZ31 alloy is impaired and fatigue properties is improved. Analysis on micro-structure evolution shows that twin and cylindrical slip play important role in tension-compression yield asymmetry and fatigue behaviors.

articleTitle: A Power Grid Start-Up Work Ticket Event Extraction Method Based on Domain Knowledge Graph Enhanced Model
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The power grid start-up work ticket event extraction has excellent challenges in its text mining. However, exiting extraction models usually rely on hand-crafted features and ignore the domain knowledge. To better understand the context knowledge of the power grid start-up work ticket, we propose a power grid start-up work ticket event extraction method based on domain knowledge graph enhanced model. Our model has several features. First, our model is a joint end-toend model. It helps to jointly perform both trigger detection and argument detection with shared parameters. Second, we integrate CNN and Bi-LSTM-CRF to detect event triggers. Third, we propose Conceptual Context Tree-LSTM (CC Tree-LSTM) with the shortest path to detect event arguments. Multiple experiments have proved that the framework of this paper is superior to other comparison methods in the Precision, Recall, and F1 score of event extraction tasks. The Precision, Recall, and F1 score of our model reach 0.8032, 0.8127, and 0.8079. It verifies the feasibility and effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Research on Key Software Testing Technology on the Operating System of Smart Meters
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The introduction of embedded operating system has become an important trend in the field of smart electricity meters in view of the new requirements of IR46 standard and emerging new business scenarios for smart meters. However, the current conventional meter verification and test items do not involve testing for the function, performance and reliability of the operating system. The blind area of the conventional test will become a potential risk point affecting the quality of the new generation of smart meters. This paper puts forward a software testing method based on the hierarchical structure and operating principle of the new smart meter operating system. Through reliability testing technologies such as fault injection and scenario simulation, combined with the method of test-APP implantation of management core, this method realizes in-depth testing and comprehensive monitoring of operating system process operation, thread scheduling, resource utilization, and response efficiency, which provides a means for testing and analyzing the operating system software quality of smart meters.

articleTitle: Multi-scale optimization of cogeneration system based on S-CO2 Brayton cycle
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the related theories of physical modeling of thermal fluids based on Modelica language are studied, and the existing model libraries are reprogrammed around the supercritical CO2 Bretton system. The model of supercritical CO2 circulation system is built and validated, and the factors affecting the operating efficiency of the system are studied. Coupled with the CCHP system, the three-stage synergistic optimization of the CCHP system as a whole is carried out, and the optimal solutions of energy utilization, annual operating cost and greenhouse gas emission are obtained.

articleTitle: Load frequency control of interconnected power system considering energy storage
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: This paper considers the system parameter uncertainty and the control delay of the energy storage system, the load frequency control (LFC) model of the wind-storage interconnected power system is established, and the sliding mode frequency controller is designed for the LFC model with the wind power and energy storage. The coordinated control strategy of the load frequency controller reduces the configuration capacity of the energy storage system and improves the robustness of the system. Through simulation analysis, it is verified that the proposed control strategy can effectively reduce the system frequency deviation and improve the and stability of the power system operation under the system load fluctuations.

articleTitle: Research on coordinated allocation method of photovoltaic energy storage in load center district (county)
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Aiming at the current research hot issues such as how to rationally configure energy storage capacity and effectively control energy storage to obtain good optical storage system operating characteristics for energy storage photovoltaic power stations, the theory of "peak cutting and valley filling" is used to optimize load control. Based on the photovoltaic energy storage system, optimize the cost of energy storage configuration. Combine load and cost control data to get a reasonable configuration result.

articleTitle: Advances on chlorine fixation properties of alkali activated cementitious materials
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: With the continuous expansion of the number and scale of sea related projects, the destructive effect of chloride ions on structures in the ocean has attracted more and more attention. Based on the existing research results, this paper expounds the chlorine fixation mechanism of alkali activated cementitious materials from three aspects: hydration products, chlorine fixation methods and influencing factors. This paper summarizes the research on the chlorine fixation performance of alkali activated cementitious materials at home and abroad, and puts forward the direction worthy of research in the future.

articleTitle: An Auxiliary Strategy for Real-time Optimal Dispatch of Microgrids Based on XGBoost Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Real-time optimal dispatch is an important part of microgrid operation, which is of great significance to the safety and stability of system. With the access of large-scale uncontrollable renewable energy resources, microgrid is gradually evolving into a new system with openness, complexity and uncertainty. The traditional model-driven optimal dispatch strategy has been difficult to meet the actual needs. Machine learning algorithm provides a new solution for system scheduling. This paper proposes a novel auxiliary strategy for real-time optimal dispatch of microgrids based on XGBoost algorithm. Specifically, the historical operating data of microgrid is used to establish a XGBoost-based dispatch model, which can directly construct the relationship between the operating status and the dispatch decision so as to provide the auxiliary strategy quickly. The grid-connected microgrid located in Guigang, Guangzhou is taken as a case for verification, and the optimal dispatch results of DNN algorithm and LSTM algorithm are compared and analyzed. Simulation results prove the effectiveness of the proposed model and algorithm.

articleTitle: Development of a 500kV 15mA power supply for ion accelerator
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The research object of this paper is the high voltage power supply for ion implantation machine. The main objective is to develop and design a 500kV/15mA high voltage power supply for ion accelerator. The main predetermined indicators of the power supply are: 500kV/15mA high voltage DC output, the ripple is less than 0.1%, the frequency of charging voltage of high voltage multiplier is greater than 20kHz. This paper mainly studied and designed the hardware topology of the main circuit of power supply, and divided the main circuit into low voltage part and high voltage part by analyzing its structure. As for the low voltage part: the rectifier circuit, inverter circuit and resonant circuit are analyzed and designed in detail; as for the high voltage part: the step-up transformer and voltage doubling circuit are analyzed and designed in detail. Finally, the feasibility of the theoretical design is verified by computer simulation and experimental prototype.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of FFT AC sampling algorithm in medium voltage distribution terminal
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: This paper expounds the importance of data acquisition in distribution terminal. In this paper, two common algorithms of AC power sampling in distribution network power parameters are derived and studied. This paper presents a practical hardware and software design scheme of three-phase AC voltage and current sampling, which has a certain engineering application reference value.

articleTitle: Research on power-frequency overvoltages of 220 kV offshore cable transmission system in Liaoning Province
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Since the power-frequency overvoltages can have a great impact on the safe operation of the submarine cable transmission system, it is necessary to calculate the overvoltages that may occur under actual situations. In this study, PSCAD (EMTDC) is used to calculate the power-frequency overvoltages of the submarine cable transmission system of the offshore oil-gas field group located near Liaoning Province. Under the conditions considered in this study, the maximum power-frequency overvoltage occurs in the case of single-phase fault earthing at the submarine cable joint in L4, which is 1.134 p.u. The result meets the limit of relevant regulations for the 220 kV transmission system, indicating that the submarine cable transmission system can operate safely and effectively, which can provide important guiding significance for the construction and operation of the system.

articleTitle: Molecular dynamics simulation of interfacial thermal resistance properties of BNNS/PP thermally conductive composites
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Polypropylene is a commonly used environment-friendly material and has a broad application prospect. To develop polypropylene based composites with high thermal conductivity, the thermal resistance properties of boron nitride nanosheet (BNNS)/polypropylene composites at the interface were investigated using the reverse nonequilibrium molecular dynamics simulation (RNEMD) method, mainly considering the effect of the number of BNNs layers on the thermal conductivity at the interface. The results of the study show that the interface thermal resistance tends to increase significantly and then stabilize as the number of boron nitride layers increases.

articleTitle: Research on automatic verification technology of virtual circuit in intelligent substation based on standard terminal library
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Intelligent substations are based on virtual circuits for signal transmission between devices, which is very important to the operation of the substation. Before the substation is put into operation, the SCD file needs to be checked for virtual circuits. This paper proposes an automatic verification method for virtual circuit of intelligent substation based on standard terminal library. The standard terminal library is established based on Levenshtein distance fuzzy matching algorithm to solve the problem of non-standard substation configuration file model. It also introduces Word2Vector similarity to improve the editing operation weight setting to improve the accuracy of the algorithm. The verification template is established based on the standard terminal library and the SCD file that has passed the review to realize the automatic verification of the virtual circuit. And the feasibility of the proposed method is verified by an example.

articleTitle: Integrated Energy Allocation Model Based on Multi-Energy Load-Storage Coordination
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: In view of the fuzziness and randomness of distributed generation and load, the common uncertain power flow analysis method of power system is used to deal with the uncertain variables with regularity and specific probability distribution. In this paper, the concept of the stochastic fuzzy model is proposed, and the stochastic fuzzy model of the source and load part is established. Based on the stochastic fuzzy theory, the energy flow relationship of the multi-energy system containing electricity, heat, gas, and other forms of energy is modeled. The improved semi-invariant method is used to solve the uncertain hybrid power flow. The semi-invariant algorithm is used for the joint decentralized solutions, and the effectiveness of the proposed planning method in multi-area and the multi-energy system is verified by a simulation example. It is proved that the research method in this paper is of great significance to the collaborative planning of regional multienergy systems and the energy regulation and operation management of the whole system.

articleTitle: Research on comprehensive energy data fusion method based on semantic association feature mining
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: With the promotion of the construction of urban integrated energy system, there are more and more intelligent businesses such as distributed energy access control and distribution automation. The storage and processing of massive associated data need reliable business perception, calculation, analysis and processing models, so as to better support the real-time analysis and intelligent processing of local businesses of integrated energy. This paper proposes an integrated energy data fusion method and device. The intelligent terminal collects multi service scenario data and completes the preliminary screening of multi-source heterogeneous data of integrated energy through data cleaning. Based on the simplified echo state network, the structure of the reserve pool is simplified into a ring topology composed of neural unit nodes, so as to reduce the complexity of the reserve pool in the echo state network, realize the perception of multiple types of power business, and then use the semantic association feature mining method to extract the data features and realize the heterogeneous fusion of multi-source data. Through verification and analysis, the method proposed in this paper effectively improves the accuracy of business recognition and fusion efficiency.

articleTitle: The Site Selection Method for Shared Photovoltaic, Charging and Energy Storage Building System
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Under the carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals, buildings should also be transformed from energy consumers to contributors. This paper first proposes a shared operation mode of photovoltaic, charging and energy storage building system, which can also provide charging service for other electric vehicle users. Further, we propose a locating method for the building system based on big data and the application of improved analytic hierarchy process. The results show that the proposed method balances the demands of the building system as a residential building, an electric vehicle charging station, and the needs of decision makers to provide the most appropriate siting options with objective big data analysis results.

articleTitle: Research on the influence of large-scale energy storage’s feed-in on the frequency stability of power grid’s receiving-end
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: In recent years, due to the decrease of energy storage battery cost, the inflection point of commercial operation has been broken through so that energy storage application enters a period of explosive growth. During the China’s "14th fiveyear- plan" period, energy storage cost will be expected to continue to decrease, while the battery cycle life would maintain gradually increase. As a result, it is possible that the large-scale electrochemical energy storage could be applied in power grid. On the account of the excellent power control performance, the large-scale energy storage will play an important role in improving the consumption of renewable energy, ensuring the stable operation of AC/DC hybrid power grid and reducing the investment of peak load regulation. In this paper, the power flow equation and the motor swing equation are combined to analyze the influence of different energy storage distribution on the system frequency transition process. Then, by simulating the electromechanical coupling characteristic of traditional generators, the procedure of energy storage converter responding to grid frequency is researched. In the end, energy storage’ virtual equivalence is proposed to compare with synchronous generator’s frequency regulation capability.

articleTitle: Fluorescence Characteristics of DAST in Silica Nanoparticles
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: 4-N, N-dimethylamino-4'-N'-methyl-stilbazolium tosylate (DAST) is well-known as one of the most important organic optical materials, but its fluorescence properties require further investigations. In this work, the fluorescence of DAST molecules encapsulated in silica nanoparticles (DAST@SNPs) was measured. Results reveal that blue-shift of the fluorescence peak and large enhancement of the fluorescence intensity were measured when DAST@SNPs were formed. Particularly, the fluorescence intensity of DAST@SNPs is 52.5 times stronger than that of pure DAST aqueous solution, meanwhile the emission peak of the former blue-shifts obviously from 604 nm for the latter to 591 nm.

articleTitle: Structure simulation comparison of the underwater vehicle thermal jet at oval discharge port
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: In order to explore the influence on the thermal jet created by the structure of discharge port. In this paper, the simulation models of different radius-ratio oval discharge ports are established. Using CFD method to conduct relevant research and analysis on the characteristics of the underwater vehicle thermal jet from different radius-ratio oval discharge ports. The calculation results show that the temperature attenuation characteristics and the surface temperature characteristics have obvious feature changes by adjusting the radius-ratio of discharge port. The float height and surface maximum temperature of thermal jet have a significant decrease under the action of 4:25 radius-ratio oval discharge port, and the surface maximum diffusion distance in Y-Axis has a good inhibitory effect.

articleTitle: Dynamic Evaluation Model of Accounting Information System Credibility Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: In order to promote the stable and healthy development of the accounting information system, certain measures need to be taken to allow users to intuitively understand the credibility level of the accounting information system. For this reason, this paper designs a dynamic evaluation model for the credibility of accounting information systems based on data mining. The article uses data mining methods to extract credibility features, and establishes a credibility evaluation index system based on the feature extraction results. Based on the evaluation index system, this article quantitatively analyzes the credibility and uses the structural hole theory to dynamically measure the credibility level of the accounting information system. The results show that the highest accuracy of the evaluation results of the proposed method is about 85%, and the highest sensitivity is 0.82, indicating that the method has a better application effect.

articleTitle: High-performance electrode material of MnCo2O4 and Graphene with dandelion morphology for supercapacitor
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Supercapacitors are high-efficiency energy storage devices between traditional capacitors and batteries, which have higher power density than traditional capacitors and longer cycle life than batteries, so they are attracting more and more attention. In this study, the supercapacitor electrode with three-dimensional dandelion morphology was prepared from MnCo2O4 and reduced graphene oxide (rGO) directly on nickel foam (NF) through a one-step hydrothermal method and annealing process. The electrode exhibits high electrochemical properties in 6 mol/L KOH electrolyte. The specific capacitance can reach 3396 F/g at a current density of 1 A/g. When the current density is increased from 1 A/g to 10 A/g, the specific capacitance only decreases from 3396 F/g to 2500 F/g, and the specific capacitance retention rate can reach 73.62%, showing a good multiplicative performance.

articleTitle: Study on energy flow calculation of decomposed method for integrated energy system
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The coordinated utilization of various energy sources is an important way of green and low-carbon development. The multi energy flow calculation is the basis of planning, operation, optimization and dispatching in integrated energy system. This paper analyses the trend and existing problems of sequential method from three aspects: energy coupling model, energy flow calculation method and solution tool. Finally, an example is used to show the analysis process. The decomposed method is solved by mature software, the calculation of the subsystem is small, and the practicability is better at present. Energy hub is a powerful tool for coupling component modelling. Mode enumeration method is suitable for systems with simple operation mode. Energy bus is an extension of energy hub method, and other methods are not universal. Newton method is a general method for power, gas and heat network calculation. The advanced power flow algorithm can improve the calculation speed, and the heat and gas loop method can improve the system convergence. The cooperative operation of mature software can improve the efficiency of sequential simulation, and the software interface is the key problem. Finally, the shortcomings of decomposed method are summarized, and the future development is prospected.

articleTitle: Innovative electrode materials and electrolytes for sodium-ion batteries
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: As the demand for electrochemical energy storage mechanisms and renewable energy systems constantly increasing, lithium-ion batteries (LIBs) could not match the overwhelming demand as the single advanced rechargeable battery. Therefore, sodium-ion batteries (SIBs), as a complementary technology to LIBs, have been rapidly developed since the last decade due to the tremendous natural abundance of sodium, which could significantly save the cost of manufacturing SIBs compared to that of LIBs. In this review, the electrochemical properties of anode, cathode, and electrolyte are explained. Several promising candidates for electrodes and electrolytes were introduced based on parameters such as energy density, electrochemical stability window, conductivity, and capacity retention.

articleTitle: Lithium-ion batteries: Towards ultimate energy density
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: With the increasing use of electric vehicles, people also put forward higher requirements for the performance of electric vehicles, especially the endurance of electric vehicles. If electric vehicles want to have higher endurance, they need greater battery energy density. Therefore, it is necessary to improve the battery energy density. This paper mainly introduces the lithium-ion battery and why the application of lithium-ion batteries in electric vehicles is better than other batteries, summarizes how to improve lithium-ion batteries from three aspects: anode, cathode electrolyte. It includes the advantages and disadvantages of the carbon-based negative electrode, silicon-based negative electrode, tin-based negative electrode, nickel-rich layered structure cathode, polyhedron cathode, and high-voltage spine structure cathode, as well as the leading improvement methods and the application of fluorine and lithium alternative solvents in electrolytes.

articleTitle: The multifunctional role of graphene in automotive lithium-ion batteries
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: As electric vehicles constantly raise global attention in sustainable development, enormous efforts have been made to improve lithium-ion batteries' capacity, charging speed, and lifetime. Graphene is a promising material widely utilized in batteries due to its unique properties. It has been exploited in various parts of lithium-ion batteries, including anodes, encapsulating materials, cathode substrates, and thermal resistors. With the introduction of graphene, as-obtained batteries display enhanced performance in capacity, efficiency, and cyclability. As a result, some companies have launched electric vehicles equipped with graphene-based batteries. Despite the bright prospect of implementing graphene in lithium-ion batteries, some issues such as prohibitive costs remain to be solved. This paper covers graphene's exceptional properties, multiple production methods, wide applications in lithium-ion batteries for electric vehicles. We hope to inspire further studies in this rapidly growing field.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-energy Complementary Clean DC Delivery Considering Sending-End Resources and the Matching Mode of Receiving-End Peak Load Regulation
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: In order to achieve Chinese goals of “carbon emission peaking in 2030 and carbon neutrality in 2060” and "building a new power system with new energy as the main body", there shall be a profound change in the development trend of energy industry and a further improvement in the penetration rate of new energy. The clean hydropower cluster in Southwest China is an important base for clean power outgoing. The regulation and storage capacity of large-scale cascade hydropower may be utilized to bundle nearby wind and photovoltaic power stations for outgoing. With a typical hydropower multi-energy complementary base in southwest China as the object, this study proposes an annual power transmission curve optimization method, which takes into account both electric abandoned rate of sending ends and the power load matching rate of receiving ends, and based on the sequence matching mode of peak load regulation for the receiving-end power grid, further puts forward a daily power transmission curve optimization method for DC outgoing. Based on the optimized DC power transmission curve, this study has established a sending-end power grid system with water-wind-solar multi-energy complementary system as the core, and conducted a daily production time sequence simulation for the whole year, evaluated different wind-solar ratios for total scale, comprehensive abandoned electric rate, DC utilization hours and pooling cost, so as to give the optimal wind-solar ratio for each DC line. It is estimated that the combination operation capacity of hydropower stations for bundled wind-solar energies in southwest China can reach over 31-49 million kilowatts. Through a reasonable optimization of wind-solar power ratio considering the demand for sending-end resources and peak load regulation for receiving ends, the consumption level of new energy and the utilization efficiency of the outgoing channels can be improved effectively.

articleTitle: Solar energy utilization potentials of railway station represented large-space buildings in various climates of China
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Energy consumption intensity of large-space public buildings keeps getting significantly higher in China. With increasing popularity, solar energy utilization has been regarded as a necessary means to achieve green performance for railway stations represented large space public buildings. This study selected six typical Chinese cities, including Harbin, Urumqi, Lhasa, Beijing, Shanghai, and Guangzhou, as climate representatives. Two typical railway station models representing both large and middle scaled large-space buildings were established, and the study examined both solar heating and cooling fractions for both adapting annual and monthly statistics, in aid of theoretical calculations and simulations. The results show that middle-scale railway stations represented large-space buildings have a higher potential for solar heating than large-scale ones. While the potential of active solar cooling is also higher in large-scale railway stations. Moreover, solar heating and cooling fractions turn more inadequate through extreme seasons. The research findings can act as valuable references for active and passive solar heating as well as active solar cooling within scaled large-space buildings across China and among similar climate zones globally.

articleTitle: The vital role of anode and cathode materials in lithium-ion battery
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Nowadays, environmental issues such as air pollution and global warming have become more serious. Therefore, people devote themselves to finding green energy to mitigate and even solve environmental problems. Lithium-ion battery (LIB) is an emerging energy storage system to substitute traditional fossil fuels such as coal, gasoline, etc. Using LIBs could avoid exhaust gas emissions, which benefit our environment a lot. Above different types of batteries, LIB is most commonly used in daily life and manufacture. First of all, although the energy density of LIB is small comparing to other energy sources such as gasoline, its energy density is much larger than most batteries such as lead batteries. Second, LIB has a high voltage platform which is beneficial to compose the battery pack. Third, although people are not satisfied with the current cycle life of LIB, the cycle life of LIB still is longer than most other batteries. Additionally, LIB is environmentally friendly from production to use; there is no harmful heavy metal element referred not like some traditional batteries such as mercury battery. Therefore, LIB is a promising electricity storage system. This review article introduces some basic knowledge, including LIB mechanism, classification of the anode and cathode material about the LIB. The state-of-the-art anode materials along with cathode materials are systematically discussed, and the lookingforward prospects of LIBs are shown in the end.

articleTitle: A new design of a radiative cooler with thermal insulation capacity
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: To improve the cooling ability of a passive radiative cooler, it is necessary to fully suppress the heat transfer effect between the object and the environment. In this paper, coolers with different radiation and heat insulation capabilities are designed, and the cooling capacity of the cooler is analyzed. The results show that under the same radiation power density, the lower the thermal radiation intensity per unit volume of the cooler, the better the radiation cooling capacity.
