Under the common convective heat transfer coefficient of 10 W/m(exp 2)/K, the radiation cooling capacity increases from about 10 deg C to 53 deg C when the heat absorption depth of the cooler increases from 0.050 mm to 30 mm. The design in this paper breaks the conventional method of selecting strong radiation materials to improve the cooling capacity, and provides a new design idea for improving the performance of radiation cooling materials.

articleTitle: Multi Time Scale Wind Power Prediction Model Based on Improved ACA-LSTM Neural Network
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: A multi time scale wind power load forecasting model is proposed to optimize the parameters of LSTM model by improving ant colony algorithm. After preprocessing and normalizing the original load, Long Short-Term Memory neural network is used to construct the training model, and then the LSTM neural network is optimized by ant colony algorithm. The optimized LSTM model is applied to short-term wind power load forecasting, and compared with the traditional prediction methods, so as to achieve more accurate prediction results.

articleTitle: Research on technical scheme of version management system of smart substation automation equipment
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Aiming at the problem of insufficient automation level of version management of smart substation automation equipment, a novel technical solution for management system is proposed in this paper. The new technical solution builds basic version and extended version information for equipment, and comprehensively improves the technical level of version management for automatic equipment through four dimensions: information model, parameter file, hardware version, and software version. This method effectively improves the automatic management level of automation equipment version, and is worthy of popularization and application.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Twin System for Power Substation Situation Awareness and Operation Simulation
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Digital twin technology is considered the fundamental to realize the digitization and intelligence transformation for power industry. In this paper, a general module structure, which is composed of ontology model, data model, 3D model and simulation model, is used to build the digital twin model for a physical entity in power substation. The knowledge graph based on the graph database is built to organize the different modules in a digital twin power substation and reflect the various connections between them. Furthermore, a power substation simulation method is proposed to support the virtual operation based on the real time status of the substation. Finally, a prototype digital twin system for power substation is built. The system can provide a novel platform for immersive status display and operation process simulation, which can be applied to support the substation situation awareness, operator training and operation plan verification.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Electric Vehicles in Hybrid Alternating Current/Direct Current Charing Stations Considering Three-Phase Unbalance Constraints
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Plug-in electric vehicles (EVs) is growing rapidly nowadays. Uncoordinated charging of a large number of EVs challenges the safe and reliable operation of electric power distribution networks. In this paper, an optimal scheduling strategy is proposed for EVs in hybrid AC/DC charging stations taking into account the possible three-phase load unbalance caused by the unequal three-phase charging power brought by the AC charging piles at the charging station. A global scheduling scheme is firstly formulated to track the reference power curve set by the upper-level power grid, while fulfilling EV owners’ charging requirement, guaranteeing safe operation of distribution transformers and reducing three-phase load unbalance degree. Both slow AC charging piles and fast DC charging piles are integrated and the three-phase current unbalance factor is transformed into an equivalent format using three-phase load power. Then a rolling scheduling scheme is proposed to cope with random arrival of EVs in realistic situations. The multi-period rolling scheduling model is dynamically updated and solved at the beginning of each period such that the requirements of currently charged EVs are always satisfied. Simulations show that the proposed real-time rolling scheduling scheme provides close results compared with those obtained by the global scheduling strategy. The total load curve is flattened and the load unbalance among three phases is greatly reduced compared to scenarios where EVs are charged without coordination.

articleTitle: Research on New Energy Vehicle Detection Technology Based on Vehicle Mileage Verification Method
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: With the improvement of China's economic level, new energy vehicles (NEVs) are gradually appearing in the public eye, and the level of new energy vehicle detection technology is particularly important. In order to better promote the steady development of China's new energy vehicle industry, improving its testing technology and testing qualification standards is also an indispensable part of the development of NEVs. Therefore, the development of the new energy automobile industry requires more intelligent testing equipment and high-tech testing personnel. This article conducts research on behavior characteristic analysis model for NEVs detection, analyzes the vehicle mileage verification and vehicle trajectory similarity discrimination method, and proposes some constructive countermeasures to improve the current situation of NEVs detection industry.

articleTitle: Radiation Sensor Measurement Based on Array Cross and Series Connection
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The nuclear radiation cumulant and the nuclear radiation intensity have a certain integral relationship. Thus, the nuclear radiation information is connected with the current information through a certain conversion device, thereby establishing the internal connection between the nuclear radiation cumulant and the resistance of the spin memristor, and realizing the measurement of the nuclear emission cumulant. In this paper, the nuclear radiation cumulant sensor circuit based on a spin memristor array is further optimized. The performance of the cross array, the information processing circuit, and the reset circuit in the sensor are tested. The response under the condition of non-nuclear radiation is studied and analyzed. The effects of nuclear radiation intensity, the number of array cross points, the gain of the amplifier, and the limiting resistance on the characteristics of the sensor are studied. The simulation results show that the total resistance in each cross point of the spin memory array and the total resistance of the array remain unchanged, which overcomes the influence of the resistance change of a single spin memory on the sensor.

articleTitle: Controller Simulation of VSC-HVDC Transmission Based on Pole Placement Theory
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: This paper focuses on the research on the transient mathematical model of VSC-HVDC transmission in a synchronous rotating coordinate system, and proposes a VSC-HVDC system controller designed by pole configuration theory. Based on the inverse system method of state feedback linearization, the inverse system model of the VSC-HVDC transmission system is deduced, and the pseudo-linear system is constructed to realize the decoupling of the active power and reactive power of the VSC-HVDC transmission system. Finally, the pole configuration method is used to synthesize the pseudolinear system, and the corresponding controller is designed. The simulation results show that the controller designed with pole placement method based on the inverse system theory has excellent dynamic response characteristics under large disturbances.

articleTitle: Exploratory study of water resources project management information system
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The scientific management of water conservancy projects is a prerequisite for ensuring the steady operation of water conservancy projects, which are important infrastructures for safeguarding the green development of our agriculture, industry and ecology. However, China's current water conservancy project management has a low degree of information technology, has not formed a systematic management model and management difficulties, and other problems, can not meet the requirements of China's water information technology, resulting in serious water waste and environmental pollution. Based on this status quo, this paper designs and develops a water conservancy project management information system based on computer application technology. The system gives full play to the dynamic monitoring of water resources by 3S technology and the efficient sharing of information by computer application technology, etc. It designs and develops a highly feasible water resources project management module to improve the information level of water resources project management.

articleTitle: The Simulation Research of Hydraulic System Test Platform of 1.5MW Wind Turbines Transmission Chain
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The transmission chain of wind turbine is the key component of the unit to bear various loads of the wind. Its working characteristics are the important basis for testing the stability, reliability and safety of wind turbine. For the drive chain system, the load simulation technology of ground test system for transmission chain of 1.5MW wind turbine is proposed. According to its performance and requirements, a six-degree-of-freedom load hydraulic loading system is designed. Wind torque load is simulated by an induction motor through a reduction box and six parallel cylinders simulate yaw and flaparound non-torque loads. Using SolidWorks to model the transmission test platform, the hydraulic loading system is designed according to the wind load. Using the single cylinder hydraulic system as an example by this paper, each parameter of hydraulic system is calculated in detail and analyze the single cylinder system according to the parameters. Using fuzzy PID control, the hydraulic loading system is simulated by MATLAB /Simulink and the results show that the Hydraulic loading system has fine tracking and reproducing of wind load

articleTitle: A SOC estimation method based on LSTM with polarization characteristics
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Utilizing the emerging technology neural network and other related methods to predict the state of charge (SOC) of battery has begun to become a popular technique. In this paper, an improved long short-term memory (LSTM) network is designed to predict the SOC of battery considering the potential polarization characteristics. The existing LSTM has the defect of insufficient capture of battery characteristics. This paper proposes a new memory structure to store the extracted potential polarization characteristics of battery SOC characteristics. Specifically, for engineering implementation, the method proposed in this paper is implemented by using the popular deep learning framework, Pytoch, and simulation experiments are carried out on the NASA battery data set. The experiments demonstrate that the method proposed in this paper is more accurate than the existing methods in SOC estimation.

articleTitle: Medium and long-term power load forecasting based on an improved grey forecasting model
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Medium and long-term load forecasting is the main basis for power system planning, which is of practical significance to the planning, operation and maintenance of the power grid. Due to the influence of many uncertain factors, the prediction accuracy of medium and long-term power load forecasting is not high. To address this problem, this paper establishes an improved grey prediction model based on the combination of equal-dimensional new information (EIM) and Fourier residual correction (FRC). Firstly, from the basic principles and implementation methods of the traditional grey forecasting model, an improved grey model of EIM and an improved grey model of FRC are proposed. The basic principles, implementation methods and scope of application scope of the improved model are introduced in detail. Finally, the maximum load data of a certain city for each year from 2011 to 2020 is selected for verification. Compared with the traditional grey model, the accuracy of the prediction results is increased by 2.53%, which effectively proves the effectiveness and accuracy of the improved method.

articleTitle: Economic research on 5G base station peak regulation
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: As 4G enters the 5G era, 5G communication technology is growing quickly, and the amount of 5G communication base stations is also growing rapidly. However, the high energy consumption of 5G communication base stations have caused huge waste. In view of the above problems, combined with Communication load characteristics of 5G communication base station, this paper created a schedulable capacity model of 5G communication base station energy storage, explored the potential of energy storage to take part in the power market. Then, according to the whole life cycle theory, the economics of 5G base station using energy storage to participate in the peak regulation of the power market is studied. The life cycle cost model of 5G base station energy storage is established from two aspects: construction cost and operation cost. According to the dispatching capacity model of 5G communication base station's energy storage, this article establishes a profit model of 5G base station's energy storage participating in the peak regulation of the power market, and obtains the benefits of low storage and high generation of 5G base station. Finally, this paper analyzes the economy of 5G communication base station energy storage taking part in power grid peak regulation, providing valuable reference for the interactive project of energy storage participating in the power market.

articleTitle: Correlation Analysis Between Multivariate External Data and Power Consumption Behaviors Based on Bayesian Network
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Accurate load sensing is the key basis for flexible regulation of user side resources. Traditional load sensing methods are mainly based on the electrical characteristics such as current and power. In view of this, this paper uses non-electrical characteristics to realize the identification of power consumption behaviors, and proposes a correlation analysis method between multivariate data and power consumption behaviors based on Bayesian network. Firstly, the crawler technology is used to obtain the factors that may affect the power consumption behaviors of users from the Internet. Furtherly, the main influencing factors of power consumption behaviors are selected from many influencing factors through the correlation analysis method. Finally, the Bayesian network model is constructed and trained with historical data to realize the accurate recognition of power consumption behaviors. It is shown that the proposed method can effectively mine the internal relationship between multiple external data and the power consumption behaviors of users and owns the advantages of simple model and high recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: The numerical study on the application of chaotic synchronization in the smart grid
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: We propose a smart grid communication system which is virtualized by the mutually coupled chaotic system. In the proposed system, the semiconductor lasers are used to indicate the dispatching control centres of a municipal electric company and the controlled substations, and the two-way communication between the dispatching control centres and the controlled substations is achieved. In the simulations, we studied the small network structure which contains four lasers, the results show that by controlling the injection strength of the mutually coupled system, the selective synchronization could be reached between dispatching control centres and the controlled substations.

articleTitle: Application case of waste heat utilization technology of calcined flue gas in the production process of prebaked anode for aluminum electrolysis
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: In the calcination process in the production of prebaked anodes for aluminum electrolysis, the calcination of petroleum coke produces high-temperature flue gas with a temperature of 1200 deg C. If it is directly discharged, it will cause a great waste of heat. Cogeneration transformation to achieve the purpose of improving energy efficiency. In this paper, through the research on the production process and the utilization of waste heat of prebaked anode manufacturers for aluminum electrolysis, the reform measures for cogeneration of waste heat from calcined high-temperature flue gas are proposed, and the data is analyzed and calculated. Through the transformation of cogeneration of waste heat from calcined hightemperature flue gas, the flue gas passes through the waste heat boiler to generate superheated steam, which is used for power generation, industrial production heat and residential heating in winter. Through data analysis and calculation, in this case, in the calcination process, after using the waste heat boiler cogeneration for heat utilization, the recoverable heat is 938,506.59 GJ, equivalent to 32,021.84 tons of standard coal, which has extremely high energy, environmental and economic benefits.

articleTitle: Study on operation and maintenance of sulfur hexafluoride circuit breaker
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: During the installation and operation of sulfur hexafluoride circuit breakers in substations, various kinds of potential safety accidents may occur in sulfur hexafluoride circuit breakers. In order to ensure the safe and stable operation of electrical equipment, it is necessary to strengthen the quality supervision and management of sulfur hexafluoride gas newly produced and gas in operation. This paper describes four common faults of sulfur hexafluoride circuit breakers in substations: abnormal gas pressure of sulfur hexafluoride、 abnormal operating mechanism、 sulfur hexafluoride gas leakage and there is something inside the tank, and analyzes the maintenance strategies of sulfur hexafluoride circuit breakers. Once the fault occurs in the sulfur hexafluoride circuit breaker of the substation, it is convenient for the staff to make the correct judgment in the first time and find out the fault point, which provides time guarantee for isolating the fault point and solving the fault as soon as possible.

articleTitle: A Recommendation Algorithm that combines Rating Data and Review Text
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: There exit a huge amount of rating data and user comment in the E-commonce systems. However, it is still a difficult problem for the recommendation system to make better use of them altogether. In the literature, some use only ratings, and some use only reviews. Recently some recommendation models try to learn from comment text and rating matrix both. However, they only focus on the topic of the comment text, and do not make full use of the comment.

articleTitle: Analysis of the influence of ambiguity function deviation angle on the detection performance of phased array radar
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Based on the linear frequency modulation signal model, the pattern function of array antenna is derived in this paper, and it is introduced into the ambiguity of phased array radar. The influence of deviation from the normal direction of array antenna on the performance of phased array radar is analyzed by simulation.

articleTitle: Optimization Model of EV Load Aggregation Regulation under the Coupling of Energy and Transportation Network
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: With the growth of the quantity of electric vehicles, the coupling depth between energy and transportation network is increasing, which provides a new boundary for electric vehicle load aggregation. Combined with the coupling characteristics of energy and transportation network, this paper constructs the electric vehicle-transportation network-power grid coupling model, proposes the electric vehicle charging demand model based on network expansion and path segmentation, and then establishes the electric vehicle aggregation regulation optimization model considering charging cost, waiting cost and driving cost. The example results show that the model constructed in this paper can effectively reduce the aggregation regulation cost of electric vehicles.

articleTitle: Preparation and photocatalytic performance of g-C3N4 composite photocatalysts loaded with rice husk ash
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: At present, photocatalysis has become one of the effective methods to solve the energy crisis and environmental pollution. In response to the problem that graphite-phase carbon nitride (g-C3N4) has serious photogenerated carrier complexation during the photocatalytic degradation of pollutants, resulting in its poor photocatalytic activity, the biochar-modified g- C3N4 composite photocatalyst was constructed in the study using the biochar material rice husk ash and g-C3N4 as raw materials. The introduction of rice husk ash material can act as a good photogenerated electron transfer channel to promote the separation and transport of photogenerated carriers in the composites, and thus improve the efficiency of photocatalytic degradation of methyl orange MO as well as formaldehyde HCHO.

articleTitle: Research on communication networking method in low voltage distribution station area based on improved ant colony algorithm
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: In view of the problems that the traditional flood networking scheme brings great burden and resource waste to the communication network, and can not realize the timely treatment and fine management of faults, this paper proposes a communication networking method in the low-voltage distribution station area based on the improved ant colony algorithm, which takes the station area intelligent fusion terminal as the central node and initiates the networking process in carrier and wireless modes respectively, according to the feedback information of each node, the preliminary network topology is obtained; then, the traditional ant colony algorithm is optimized by using the path reliability weighting factor to determine the communication mode between each node, so as to realize the networking of the whole low-voltage distribution station area. In addition, the node update and maintenance are completed by minimizing the overhead. Experiments show that this method can effectively shorten the meter reading delay and relay depth, and has practical significance for the communication networking in low-voltage distribution station area.

articleTitle: Research on Transmission Model of Hydropower Unit State Information Based on Data Distribution Strategy
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: There is a problem of unbalanced load of information resources in the transmission of hydropower unit state information, resulting in low transmission speed. The transmission model of hydropower unit state information is constructed based on the data distribution strategy. The unit status information of hydropower station includes the "remote signaling and telemetry" data for monitoring and the interactive data of multiple status detection modules and fault diagnosis modules. The unit status information is extracted by means of periodic acquisition, random acquisition and call acquisition. The time alignment processing method based on asynchronous event driven mechanism is adopted to update all kinds of data received in real time and respond to the network connection and data transmission requests sent by the master station. The data distribution strategy is used to allocate the state information resources of hydropower units to realize the resource collaborative control. Through the response of the data distribution center to the data request, the information transmission is completed according to the size of the data obtained by the data query service. The test results show that the hydropower station unit state information transmission model based on data distribution strategy can improve the transmission speed and provide high-speed and high broadband communication services.

articleTitle: Connection pattern recognition for medium-voltage distribution network in power supply area
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Connection pattern recognition is the basis of distribution system planning and evaluation. Integrated with a connection pattern model for 10kV urban medium-voltage distribution networks, here proposes a connection pattern recognition method based on topology analysis and clustering algorithm. For analysis the network structure, the depth-first search algorithm is adopted to divide a complete network into outlet trees, which are the research object of connection pattern recognition. Typical power grid structures of 10kV distribution network are analyzed, including overhead network and cable network. On this basis, the features of typical connection modes belonging to each grid structure are extracted and analyzed respectively, and feature expressions as well as feature database are established to cover all typical modes. Finally, the clustering algorithm is utilized to match the features of unknown connection modes with the centers of class, whose cluster centers are composed with the typical modes. The recognition results of an example network validate the feasibility of the proposed algorithm, which has guiding significance for the planning and construction of medium-voltage distribution networks.

articleTitle: Fault Transient Characteristics Analysis of Double-Terminal Flexible DC Distribution Networks Considering Distributed Renewable Integration
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The DC distribution network is witnessing a rapid growth recently because of its ability of friendly integration of renewable energy. However, the fault characteristics and insulation coordination strategies in DC distribution networks are not fully analysed yet. To bridge this gap, this paper focuses on the fault transient characteristics analysis. By setting up a complete model of double-terminal flexible DC distribution network, the fault transient characteristics at key components on AC/DC side as well as inside the converter station are simulated and analysed. Based on this, reasonable insulation coordination methods can be proposed, which will be instructive to the DC distribution network operation and protection.

articleTitle: Research on Insulation Aging Law of Switchgear Operating for Different Years under Actual Conditions
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: As the key equipment in the power system, the switchgear has an increasing proportion of over-aged equipment, which seriously threatens the safe and reliable operation of the power system. However, there is almost no effective method to evaluate the insulation aging state of these over-aged switchgear. In this paper, the electric field distribution of highvoltage switchgear was obtained by finite element simulation with the software, COMSOL, and some weak points of the switchgear have been observed. Then, samples were taken from the key insulation parts of switchgears that have been in operation for different years. And the dielectric properties, the mechanical properties and the infrared spectral absorption properties of the samples were tested and compared. Studies have shown that with the increase of operating years, the internal structure of the switchgear insulation will change, resulting in deterioration in its electrical and mechanical properties.

articleTitle: Analysis of PEM electrolytic cell structure and flow channel form on electrolysis efficiency
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: In order to explore the effect of the flow channel form of the electrolytic cell and the porosity of the diffusion layer on the hydrogen production efficiency of the proton exchange membrane. The effects of square flow channel, arched flow channel and triangular flow channel on hydrogen production were compared by simulation method, and it was concluded that the square flow channel can help to enhance the hydrogen production efficiency of the electrolytic cell. The influence of the porosity of the diffusion layer on the hydrogen production efficiency of the electrolytic cell was analyzed, and the simulation results showed that the smaller the porosity of the diffusion layer, the higher the mass fraction of hydrogen.

articleTitle: Research on short-term photovoltaic power prediction method based on WOA-SVM
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: To predict photovoltaic power generation more accurately, aiming at the problem of low prediction accuracy caused by improper parameter selection in the support vector machine model, a short-term photovoltaic output prediction model based on a whale optimization algorithm to optimize support vector machine parameters is proposed. Firstly, the whale optimization algorithm is used to optimize the parameters of the support vector machine. Secondly, the optimized algorithm model is used for photovoltaic power output prediction. Finally, the output power of photovoltaic power stations under three different weather conditions is predicted and simulated. The prediction results are compared with the prediction results of SVM, PSO-SVM, and ARIMA methods. The results show that the WOA-SVM algorithm can effectively improve the accuracy of short-term photovoltaic power prediction.

articleTitle: Adaptive dynamic bias ultra low power LDO
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: In this paper, an adaptive dynamic bias low dropout regulator based on 180nm CMOS process is designed for low-power management of wireless sensor networks in the Internet of things. The key problems in the design of ultra-low power LDO are studied, including the improvement of system stability and transient response. The miller compensation scheme is improved to improve the system stability; At the same time, the adaptive bias current technology is used to improve the transient response performance of the load, and the low power consumption in standby mode is realized by reducing the bias current. The contradiction between low power consumption and fast transient response is solved. LDO can realize 600mV stable output voltage from 1.2V to 1.8V power supply voltage, with a dropout voltage of 150mV, quiescent current of 1.1uA and power consumption of 1.32uW.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Energy-saving and Monitoring Management Cloud Platform for Urban Street Lamps Based on 5G Communication
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Urban road lighting system is one of the symbols of urbanization and it is also an important part of urban energy consumption. In order to reduce the energy waste of urban street lamps and realize the intelligent lighting of street lamps, this paper designed an intelligent energy saving and monitoring management system for urban street lamps based on 5G mobile communication and cloud platform. The system realizes long-distance and low-latency communication between terminal equipment and WISE-PaaS cloud platform through 5G CPE module and IoT cloud platform, and adopts fuzzy control algorithm realize Intelligent energy-saving control of city street lights. Compared with the existing traditional lighting system, this system can not only realize large-scale networking, but also use the advantages of cloud platform technology to realize remote monitoring and alarm functions on the mobile terminal. It has the characteristics of high security and good scalability, 5G and the Internet of Things can meet the requirements of application scenarios of system terminals.

articleTitle: Research on isothermal fatigue behaviors and mechanism of Mg-12Gd- 3Y-0.5Zr magnesium alloy at different temperatures
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Isothermal fatigue tests were carried out on Mg-12Gd-3Y-0.5Zr magnesium alloy at room temperature and high temperatures. The experimental results indicates that fatigue strength of Mg-12Gd-3Y-0.5Zr magnesium alloy decrease not apparently with increasing temperature up to 200 deg C, but drop sharply at 235 deg C which is due to newly activated slip system. The fatigue mechanism of Mg-12Gd-3Y-0.5Zr magnesium alloy was analyzed by Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM). The factor of temperature variation which lead to cyclic slip and oxidation is main fatigue failure mechanism.

articleTitle: An image encryption algorithm based on improved low dimensional chaotic system
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Low dimensional chaotic system has the advantages of simple structure, fast iteration speed and easy implementation. It is widely used in the field of security. However, it also has some defects, such as small key space, uneven output distribution and empty window area. On the basis of other researchers, this paper adds disturbance operation to the Logistics- Sine map, associates the system parameters with the random sequence generated by the system and affects each other, which improves the problem that the output sequence of the original system is not random enough. In order to prove the practicability and applicability of the improved system, a new dynamic image encryption algorithm for scrambling and diffusion at the same time is designed. The image summary is generated by hash function and combined with the key to achieve the purpose of one picture and one encryption. Through simulation experiments, it is proved that the algorithm has high encryption efficiency, can resist various common attack methods, and has certain application value.

articleTitle: Research on New Energy Vehicle Detection Technology Based on Vehicle Mileage Verification Method
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the research on the optimal control of the integrated energy system with the target of the optimal new energy consumption rate is carried out for this problem. First, we established an optimal configuration model for the photovoltaic energy storage system. Then, with the goal of maximizing new energy consumption, a peak-valley-level period optimization model based on new energy consumption is established. Finally, the simulation shows that the integrated energy system with the optimal new energy consumption rate can smooth the peak-valley difference of the power grid.

articleTitle: Power Control Strategy of Bidirectional Converter in Low Voltage AC/DC Hybrid Microgrid
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The bidirectional converter is at the core of the hybrid microgrid, and it plays the role of power between two subnets. In order to realize the power flow and balance between two subnets, a power control strategy for hybrid microgrid is proposed. First, this paper analyzes the droop characteristics of the microgrid under low-voltage conditions, introduces the difference in voltage fluctuations between two subnets, designs the power mutual assistance target coefficient, and proposes a power control strategy. Finally, a model was built in Matlab/Simulink to verify the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Analysis and Verification of Nuclear Power Cabinet Magnetic Field Radiation Emission Test
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) is an important part of equipment and an important guarantee for its reliable operation. With the digitization of the instrumentation and control system of nuclear reactors, the electromagnetic compatibility of I&C system is being brought to more and more attention. This paper takes a Nuclear Power cabinet as an example to introduce the positioning and rectification method of the RE101 test exceeding the standard in detail. The magnetic field emission caused by the inductance coil exceeds the standard and is analyzed and summarized, and the interference suppression method is given. Finally, the correctness of the method is verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Automatic Driving and Control Technology of Unmanned Aerial Vehicle with High Precision Positioning System
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: With the continuous development of UAV technology, UAV needs to automatically collect and process the surrounding environmental data and information, and fly to the set target point or interest point independently. In the future, the flight intelligence level of UAV will be higher and higher. Based on the control technology of UAV autopilot and high-precision positioning system, the basic principle and function of UAV autopilot are discussed, the controller of high-precision positioning system is analyzed, the positioning model PIO algorithm is proposed, and the positioning errors of PIO, PSO and ABC algorithms are compared, as well as the comparison between airport tracking algorithm and UAV cooperative dawsn algorithm. The results show that under the same number of iterations, the accuracy of PIO algorithm is basically better than the other two algorithms. When the error probability is less than 0.7, the PIO algorithm proposed in this paper has good positioning accuracy. When p is 0, mlcrf algorithm adopts UAV cooperative positioning. In the process of crossing the network area, the broadcast position distribution of UAV is more uniform, which can improve the positioning accuracy. Therefore, when the error is low, the positioning error is relatively large. Therefore, compared with the other two algorithms, PIO algorithm can obtain better positioning accuracy.

articleTitle: First-principles study on electronic structure and optical properties of two-dimensional antimonene doped with phosphorus
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: In recent years, two-dimensional antimonene has become an attractive two-dimensional wide band gap semiconductor material in the field of optoelectronic and nano-devices. In this paper, the electronic structure and optical properties of single-layer antimony (Sb)and doped with phosphorus (P) are studied by first principle. The results show that the forbidden band of antimony alkene is indirect forbidden band, and the forbidden band width is 1.27 eV. After doping P, the band gap of antimony-ene becomes a direct band gap, which is 1.37 eV. This shows that the light utilization rate of the doped antimony alkene is improved compared with that of undoped antimony alkene. At the same time, we have also studied their optical properties, and found that the dielectric properties of doped materials have been improved. It can be seen from the absorption spectrum that the doping curve has a red shift.

articleTitle: Temporal convolutional neural network with self-attention for shortterm load forecasting
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The operation of the power system becomes more flexible and uncertain as the electrical market reform continues to develop, requiring smart grid data processing efficiency, intelligence analysis, and processing technology. Temporal Convolutional Networks (TCN) are a specific design for forecasting problems that offers advantages over recurrent networks. In this paper, a hybrid method is proposed temporal convolutional neural network with self-attention (TCN-SA) for short-term load forecasting that can make more accurate predictions by extracting multi-scale characteristics than other existing methods. We apply it to an open dataset and comparisons with existing models show that the proposed model provides accurate load forecasting results.

articleTitle: Ascorbic Acid Induced Scrolling of Titanium Carbide Ti3C2Tx MXene Nanosheets
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Because of its exceptional mechanical/chemical properties, MXenes, the two-dimensional transition metal carbides/nitrides, holds great potential in varied fields. Here, we demonstrate a simple method to fabricate Ti3C2Tx MXene nanoscrolls with the assistance of ascorbic acid (AA). It is worth mentioning that sonication treatment and the choice of solvents are critical to make MXene nanoscrolls successfully. It is discovered that AA molecules are intercalated into the interlayer spacing and bind to the Ti3C2Tx surface, which should be responsible for the scrolling up of MXene nanosheets. Moreover, changing the MXene morphology from sheets into scrolls also changes the material’s electrical and mechanical properties. This work offers a new strategy of fabricating MXenes scrolls for possible applications in structural composites and flexible electronics.

articleTitle: Automatic Early Warning Technology of Automatic Pipeline Fault based on Cluster Analysis
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The existing automatic early warning technology has the problem of unclear security threshold, which leads to low clustering purity. This paper designs an automatic pipeline fault early warning technology based on clustering analysis. According to the current running state of the automatic pipeline equipment, the adaptive security threshold is set by clustering analysis, the automatic warning notification model is constructed, the warning function modules are divided, the particle swarm optimization algorithm is improved, the automatic warning mode is set, and the optimal clustering results are searched. Experimental results: the average clustering purity of the designed automatic early warning technology and the two conventional automatic early warning technologies are 1.229, 0.8885 and 0.921 respectively, which proves that the automatic early warning technology combined with cluster analysis technology has higher use valuet.

articleTitle: Design of Digital Logic Gate Based on Memristor
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a new CMOS-memristor hybrid structure called 3T1M is proposed. Based on this structure, a memorycomputing integration of the AND gate, a memory-computing integration of the OR gate, a memory-computing integration of the universal logic gate, and a memory-computing integration of the universal logic gate with parity bit are presented. By theoretical analysis and simulation verification, these logic gate structures can complete Boolean logic operations, store and readout functions of input data, and make the function of a gate circuit that can both calculate and store data. They can all be compatible with CMOS circuits. Through LTspice simulation, the theoretical feasibility of the proposed design is proved. In these structures, the memristor acts as both an operation device and a storage device, thus accomplishing the integration of storage and calculation, saving the circuit area and solving the problem that MRL logic circuits carry out Boolean logic operations without storing and reading data.

articleTitle: LSTM-Luong algorithm based on entrepreneurial index closing price prediction research
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: In order to study the future overall trend of newly created, high-growth enterprises in China, the trend prediction of the GEM index for its index price is made. In this paper, four algorithmic models, RNN model, LSTM model, LSTM_Bahdanau model, and LSTM_Luong model, are used to make predictions on the closing price data of the GEM index, aiming to find the most advantageous, more stable, more accurate prediction performance, and more suitable for the GEM index. Through comparison experiments, the LSTM_Luong model performs well in five indexes: mean absolute error (MAE), mean absolute percentage error (MAPE), root mean square error (RMSE), mean square error (MSE), and coefficient of determination, and the model is improved, with its MAE improving by 5.4 percentage points and RMSE improving by 3.5 percentage points, and its stability was improved.

articleTitle: Research on the adaptability of power system considering the scale of large-scale wind power consumption
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Through the method of system hierarchical modeling, the analysis and evaluation method of system adaptability after large-scale wind power integration is deeply studied. Starting from the analysis of four different levels of random production simulation, unit maintenance plan, peak shaving, and frequency regulation, according to the change characteristics of load, wind power, power grid and power supply under different time scales, the system after the largescale wind farm is connected is given. Reliability index, annual maintenance plan and unit commitment, and focused on the calculation method of wind power curtailment at the peak and frequency regulation level and the overall wind power consumption scale. The above analysis method is applied to the Northwest Power Grid's 2020 main network planning plan, and the results obtained show that the method in this paper can provide a useful idea for planners.

articleTitle: Study on Abnormal Heating Mechanism of Composite Insulators with Typical Defects
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: In recent years, abnormal heating failure of composite insulators occurs frequently in China, which brings hidden dangers to the safe operation of power grid. In order to study the abnormal heating mechanism of composite insulators, the temperature rise experiments of 500 kV composite insulators and short-string composite insulators with artificial simulation defects are carried out respectively. The effects of umbrella cover contamination, interface air gap and water intrusion on abnormal heating of composite insulators are systematically discussed. The results show that the abnormal heating of composite insulators can be divided into two main types: 1) temperature rise at high voltage end; 2) temperature rise at non-high voltage end. The former is heat source on the umbrella sleeve, which is caused by polarization loss of polar groups and invading water caused by aging of umbrella sleeve; and the latter is mainly caused by resistance loss of conductivity defects, which include polluted umbrella sleeve, sheath penetration cracking and deterioration of mandrel. Usually, the heating area and temperature rise of the latter are larger than that of the former. In addition, the combined action of moisture and heat will accelerate the deterioration and moisture absorption process of composite insulators, especially when there are air gap defects at the interface of composite insulators, moisture absorption will be more rapid and intensified, and abnormal temperature rise will be higher.

articleTitle: Rotor parameter optimization method for groove torque reduction of built-in permanent magnet synchronous motor
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Because of the groove structure of the motor itself, there is groove torque in the permanent magnet synchronous motor, and the existence of groove torque will inevitably cause the decline of motor performance. Therefore, a way of optimizing Rib and Hrib rotor parameters of PMSM was proposed to decrease the groove torque of PMSM by changing the polar arc coefficient. The relationship between Rib and Hrib parameters and groove torque was analyzed based on the expression, and the optimal combination of parameters was determined by finite element parameterization calculation in the specified parameter interval. The comparison between the optimized results and the non-optimized results shows that when the parameters Rib=15mm and Hrib=4.4mm, the groove torque decreases from 1.29N.m to 0.28N.m, down nearly 78.30%, and the reduction effect is significant. Finally, simulation analysis shows that the optimization has little effect on air gap flux density and no-load back potential.

articleTitle: Design of a high power LED constant current driver
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a high power LED constant current drive circuit based on BUCK circuit is designed. The circuit has the characteristics of wide input voltage range (6V~42V), high efficiency, high integration, high reliability, small volume and so on. Inside the circuit integrated 1.5A power PMOS; In order to improve the reliability of the system, the circuit is integrated with LDO module, bias current module, digital dimmer module, overtemperature protection module, logic control module and driver module. Through Cadence software for basic circuit module and system parameters of the simulation and optimization, the results show that the control circuit based on conduction time control mode to achieve the high precision, and has a wide range of input voltage, low voltage reference source and PWM dimming function, such as driving current can be up to 1.5 A, and no compensation will be able to steady work.

articleTitle: A Spatiotemporal Charging Load Forecast of Electric Taxis Based on Travel Probability Matrix
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: With the large-scale popularization of electric taxis, their random charging load has gradually formed the characteristics of two-dimensional distribution in time and space. In order to analyze the specific distribution situation of the charging load, it is necessary to accurately describe the travel characteristics of taxis. Therefore, this paper proposes a spatiotemporal charging load forecast method of electric taxis based on travel probability matrix. Firstly, a single electric taxi model and a traffic network model are established respectively, in which the impact of urban road flow on the traffic speed is reflected by a speed-flow model. Secondly, a travel probability matrix is constructed to realize the travel simulation of a single electric taxi. Thirdly, based on above models, the spatiotemporal distribution results of electric taxis charging load in urban areas can be obtained through Monte Carlo simulation. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by taking the actual traffic network in a certain area as an example. The simulation results show that the electric taxis charging load has different distribution characteristics in different functional areas.

articleTitle: Research on a Microwave Band - pass Filter
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: This paper introduces a broadband microwave bandpass filter. The structure of the filter is a filter cavity formed by two balanced dielectric sheets. On the two dielectric sheets, the relative face of the microwave input end and the microwave output end is symmetrically provided with a guided wave surface, the middle face is symmetrically provided with a filter groove surface for filtering, and the surface of an exponential curve structure is arranged along the microwave transmission direction, A plurality of arc-shaped filter grooves are arranged on the opposite surface of the dielectric sheet perpendicular to the microwave transmission direction. This special structure is analyzed and calculated by the finite difference time domain method. The results show that the filter can fully improve the subwavelength binding effect in microwave band and make the anti electromagnetic interference ability of the filter better.

articleTitle: Research on quantitative transportation system of cementing plugging Material based on fuzzy PID control
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: In order to improve the precision of quantitative transportation of cementing and plugging material, the system has better stability and effectiveness. In this paper, the mathematical model of quantitative transportation system of cementing plugging material is established and the transfer function of the system is established. Control system to configure the cementing mud flow of clear water to control the cementing plugging material throughput, plugging material weight change in the bin as a set value, through the inverter control asynchronous motor to drive the rotation of the rotary feeder so that plugging material from the bin down to the pneumatic conveying pipeline. In this paper, the simulation model of closedloop control, closed-loop PID control and fuzzy PID control is built, and the comparative study of the three control methods is carried out. The research results confirm that fuzzy PID control has better robustness and responsiveness, and the control effect is better than the simple PID control.

articleTitle: Advances of non-metallic materials resistant to hydrochloric acid corrosion
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Hydrochloric acid is an important inorganic chemical raw material, which is widely used, but it is extremely corrosive. In order to solve the problem of material selection under the condition of hydrochloric acid, this paper presents an overview on the classification, application, practical use status and research progress of non-metallic materials resistant to hydrochloric acid corrosion, so as to provide technical basis and references for the application of non-metallic materials in the future.

articleTitle: Accommodation capability evaluation method of large-scale renewable energy power connected with power grid
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: It is the key link to promote the efficient utilization of renewable energy by objectively evaluating the accommodation capability of the large-scale renewable energy power connected with power grid. In this paper, the accommodation capability evaluation method of large-scale renewable energy power connected with power grid is proposed. The basic characteristics and influencing factors of renewable energy power are analyzed. Considering the benefits brought by renewable energy and aiming at minimizing the system operation cost, the operation optimization model of power system with large-scale renewable energy power is established. The case studies of a certain region demonstrate the effectiveness of proposed method in accommodation capability evaluation of large-scale renewable energy. The research results of this paper have a certain significance for the development of renewable energy and generation expansion planning.

articleTitle: Analysis of The Accurate Service Mode of Information Resources
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: With the rapid development of the times and the popularity of the Internet, as well as the increasing demand for a large number of high-quality information resources in the field of user learning and scientific research, it is very necessary to provide users with accurate information resources services. This paper analyzes the significance, current situation and elements of accurate service of information resources, and puts forward the accurate service mode of information resources to meet the personalized needs of users and improve the utilization rate of resources.

articleTitle: Research on zero sequence voltage transient characteristic identification algorithm for single-phase grounding fault
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: For 10kV line outgoing line, the neutral point of transformer adopts arc suppression coil grounded or ungrounded distribution network, in case of single-phase grounding, the zero sequence fault current is weak, and the single-phase grounding fault line selection protection is difficult. This paper presents an algorithm to identify the sudden change of zero sequence voltage signal in the process of single-phase grounding fault by using the principle of time series singularity detection, determine the fault occurrence time, and detect single-phase grounding fault according to the size and polarity direction characteristics of zero sequence voltage and zero sequence current fault components at the occurrence time of grounding fault. The results of real-time digital simulation and dynamic simulation experiments of power system show that the algorithm can detect the mutation point of zero sequence voltage signal, and correctly identify the grounding fault line combined with the polarity direction characteristics of zero sequence voltage and zero sequence current fault components. RTDS simulation experiments verify the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Situation awareness of distribution network based on digital twin technique
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: With the penetration of distributed generation and electric vehicles, the randomness and uncertainty significantly impact the distribution network operations. Distribution network situation awareness is an important fundamental for the safety, reliability, and efficiency of the distribution network operation. At present, accurate perception of the distribution network situation is a challenge due to inaccurate modelling, lacking real-time measurement, and insufficient computing power. This paper investigates the key technologies of distribution network situation awareness. A digital twin model of an actual distribution network was constructed and super-resolution technology was employed to improve the resolution of measurement data. To demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed solution, a distribution network situation awareness platform was implemented based on the cloud simulation platform CloudPSS. The hardware architecture of the platform is also present and discussed. An IEEE-33 node system was used to verify the performance of the distribution network situation awareness platform, showing that the platform can significantly improve the real-time situation awareness of the distribution network.

articleTitle: Power system protection against graphite bombs
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: With the rapid development of modern science and technology, new weapons have been developed and utilized. As weapons are updated, protection measures should be improved, and then the production of new weapons might also be provoked. Preventing the electric power system from being attacked by graphite bomb is one of the important works to guarantee the safety of power supply in wartime. Based on the analysis of the working principle of graphite bomb and the characteristics of China power system, the protection measures against the threat of graphite bomb were analysed. Currently, the active protections are concentrated in radar jam signal and the passive defenses are mostly focused on the resistance capability of the power system, the rapid repair, air curtain protection, and so on. Finally, the power system should have strong anti-attack capability and ensure the safe operation as the lifeline project.

articleTitle: A -16-80V Input Common-Mode Range High-precision Current Monitor
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: A high-side current sense amplifier with wide common-mode input voltage range of -16V to 80V is proposed. The circuit is mainly composed of four main parts: power supply voltage conversion control circuit, input stage level shifter, doubleended to single-ended signal full differential amplifier and output stage signal amplifier. In the input stage, this paper proposes a new type of level shifting and signal acquisition circuit, which can accurately collect high voltage signals and translate the negative signals to the positive range. In order to obtain higher accuracy, a gain boosting circuit is added to the amplifier, increasing the gain of amplifier to 142dB, and a current feedback loop is introduced in the amplifier to optimize the linearity of the amplifier. In the output stage amplifier, a new swing optimization technique is employed to push the output swing to a region that is 0.2V lower than the power supply voltage. The current detection amplifier has a detection voltage range of 10mV to 356mV, an amplification factor of 50V/V, a maximum permissible output voltage of 17.8V, a gain error of less than 0.11 percent, and an operating temperature range of -40deg C to 125 deg C.

articleTitle: A Capacitive-Coupled Chopper Instrumental Amplifier Designed for Brain-Machine-Interface Circuits
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: This paper proposed a low-noise and low-power-consumption capacitive-coupled chopper instrumental amplifier for brain-machine-interface (BMI) circuits. Based on the dc servo loop (DSL) of an active Gm-C integrator architecture, the dc offset voltage of the electrode can be suppressed. To enhance linearity and reduce noise, an very-low-transconductance (VLT) operational transconductance amplifier (OTA) with complementary input structure is introduced into the active Gm-C integrator in the dc servo loop. This article is completed in SMIC 0.18-micrometer CMOS process, and the total power consumption is only 5.94uW under the condition of 3.3V supply voltage. Besides, the high-pass corner frequency can be precisely set and linearly adjusted from 0.65 to 15Hz by the bias current of the VLT OTA.

articleTitle: Development and Application of BIM Technology in Intelligent Construction
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: With the advent of the digital information age, it is difficult for the traditional architectural design process to match the information technology conditions and requirements of today’s industry. Therefore, BIM technology has been gradually applied in the field of intelligent construction and has become an advanced technical means applied in international construction projects. However, due to the inconsistent development of political systems and industry conditions among countries, the development status of BIM technology differs in various countries. Through an overview of the characteristics of BIM technology and a comparative analysis of the development and application of BIM technology at home and abroad, this paper discusses the application prospect of BIM technology in intelligent construction engineering and its future development in China’s construction industry.

articleTitle: Planetary gearbox fault detection of wind turbines based on chaotic particle swarm algorithm and convolutional deep belief network
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The vibration signal of planetary gearbox of wind turbine is a kind of non-linear and non-stationary complex signal. The traditional fault diagnosis method can deal with this kind of signal well in a limited range. In this paper, the convolution depth belief network is established for planetary gear-box fault diagnosis. In order to prevent the wrong selection of hyper parameters from causing insufficient recognition accuracy, particle swarm optimization algorithm is introduced to optimize the hyper parameters of the network, and the chaos initialization of particles improves the global search ability of particles. Firstly, the original signal is decomposed by VMD to extract the eigenmode function which is relatively concentrated in the impact information as the input data of the network. Then, the training set is used to train, the chaos particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to deter-mine the hyper parameters of the network according to the minimum fitness function, and the layer by layer greedy algorithm is used to continuously update the network parameters. Finally, the extracted fault features are classified by a classifier. After verification, this method can diagnose the fault of planetary gearbox under different conditions.

articleTitle: Renewable energy sources planning with uncertainties by using chance constrained planning in distribution network
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Nowadays, more and more renewable energy sources (RESs) have been integrated into distribution networks, how to address the random variables such as wind speed, irradiance and load demands in the RES planning procedure is a significant challenge. To deal with uncertainties, scenario technology is adopted. A chance constrained RESs planning model is developed using scenarios yielding from Monte Carlo sampling (MCS). Then a novel solving strategy, combining loss sensitivity factor (LSF) approach and particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is developed. Test results has demonstrated the effectivity and precision of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Synthesis and photophysical benzotriazole-based acceptors with side-chain modulation for solar cells
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: A narrow gap A-DA’D-A acceptor based on benzotriazole was designed and synthesized, named BTz-TTC9-4F. By introducing multiple fused benzotriazole and IC-4F, BTz-TTC9-4F can maintain a narrow bandgap of 1.39 eV, showing wide absorption from 500 nm to 1000 nm in spectrum, due to the introduction of benzotriazole with weak central nuclear electron absorption ability. The strong intermolecular charge transfer in the central benzotriazole and IC-2F endgroup. The compound structure of BTz-TTC9-4F was detected by 1H NMR. Not only the solubility of BTz-TTC9-4F in some organic solvents is good, but also BTz-TTC9-4F has a wide absorption making for high efficiency organic solar cells obtained.

articleTitle: Microstructure and Microwave Dielectric Properties of (1-x)SrTiO3-xLaAlO3 Ceramics
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The (1-x)SrTiO3-xLaAlO3 (x = 0.3~0.6) microwave dielectric ceramics were prepared by two-step synthesis method. The effects of LaAlO3 content on the microstructure, microwave dielectric properties and crystal structure of (1-x)SrTiO3-xLaAlO3 ceramics were investigated. The results showed that the LaAlO3 powder prepared by coprecipitation method refines the ceramic grains, and the sintering temperature was reduced by about 100 deg C compared with the traditional solid phase method. In the studied composition range, a single tetrotetic solid solution was formed. With the increase of x, the unit cell volume decreases and the quality factor Q×f increases, but the dielectric constant epsilonr and resonant frequency temperature coefficient tauf both decrease. When x = 0.4, 0.6SrTiO3-0.4LaAlO3 ceramics get the best microwave dielectric properties at 1500 deg C for 4 h: epsilonr = 42.2, Q×f = 25643 GHz, tauf = 5.5 ppm / deg C.

articleTitle: Research on Voltage Compensation Measures Based on Reducing Commutation Failure and Converter Transformer Tap Loss
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Commutation failure is one of the most common faults in HVDC transmission. The frequent action of converter transformer tap will shorten the service life and reliability of converter transformer, which may lead to commutation failure. In order to reduce the tap loss of converter transformer and suppress the occurrence of commutation failure, a method of voltage compensation with controllable voltage source on the valve side of converter transformer is proposed. Simulation results show that the proposed method not only greatly reduces the tap action of converter transformer, but also plays a certain role in restraining commutation failure.

articleTitle: Leakage Inductance Modeling and Experimental Verification of the Special-purpose Coupling Transformers of Lineside Electronic Unit (LEU)
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The leakage inductance of a coupling transformer dose not only aggravate the ringing effect of the output coding waveform of the lineside electronic unit (LEU), but also seriously affects the transmission distance of the coding signal. To solve the above problems and ensure that the LEU meets engineering requirements, the leakage inductance of transformers excited by high-frequency pulse signals is analyzed in detail, and a finite element analysis model of threedimensional transient field circuit, directly coupled with a transformer, is proposed. The inductance parameters of the transformer are calculated by magnetic energy method, which provides a basis for the design of the special coupling transformer of LEU.

articleTitle: Research on construction method of digital twin geometry of power grid station equipment based on feature matching
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: At present, the geometric modeling of the digital twin of power grid station equipment is realized by scanning the whole station by exciting radar or UAV oblique photography, and then by manual image segmentation, angle adjustment and material rendering, which has the problems of long time-consuming and high personnel requirements. In order to solve this problem, a digital twin geometry construction method of power grid station equipment based on station mapping based on feature matching is proposed. Firstly, the three-dimensional geometric data of various station equipment are obtained to construct the equipment feature database. Then determine the three-dimensional edge feature information of power equipment in the laser point cloud image of the target station, use the station equipment feature database to match the three-dimensional edge feature information of the target station equipment, and determine the station equipment of the feature database corresponding to the target station equipment. Finally, in the laser point cloud image of the target station equipment, the corresponding digital twin geometry is generated according to the feature database equipment model. This method can quickly realize the construction of digital twin geometry of primary and secondary equipment in power grid stations, and promote the application of digital twin technology in power grid.

articleTitle: Benefit evaluation method of Demand-side Response in distributed photovoltaic accommodation
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Analyzing the mechanism and feasibility of Demand-side response in distributed photovoltaic accommodation, the scenario generation and aggregation method based on Latin hypercube sampling is adopted to consider the influence of the uncertainty for photovoltaic, a benefit evaluation model of demand-side response participation in photovoltaic accommodation was established based on economic indicators, the positive influence and economic benefits of demand-side response are verified combined with examples. Research shows that by implementing Demand response, the distributed photovoltaic accommodation can be increased without changing the total electricity consumption of users, the system power generation cost can be reduced by improving the peak-to-valley difference, and the total system benefit can be increased after the response.

articleTitle: Energy management strategy of PV-energy storage microgrid based on multi-mode switching and ICSO algorithm
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: In order to effectively improve the system performance and energy utilization, an energy management strategy of PV-energy storage microgrid with multi-mode switching and inherited competitive swarm optimization algorithm is proposed. By studying the working modes of the microgrid system under different operating environments and the switching mode between each mode, the ICSO algorithm is used to realize the energy management of the microgrid by fully considering the objectives and constraints of the stable operation of the microgrid and combining with the multi-objective function. And by comparing with the system operation cost under the battery SOC management strategy, the results show that the proposed method has a lower system scheduling cost and is more economical.

articleTitle: Research and design of distributed busbar protection for distribution network
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The busbar fault probability of distribution network is high, which seriously endangers the safety of equipment. So, it is necessary to use busbar protection in distribution network. In order to improve the reliability of power supply, a scheme of busbar protection based on power direction is proposed, and the implementation plan that can adapt to different distribution systems are given. This protection can quickly identify and remove busbar faults, and is compatible with abnormal communication, switch failure and TV break. At the same time, it does not increase project investment and construction cost, which can be popularized in distribution network.

articleTitle: A Rough Set-Based Integrity Checking Method for Relay Protection Data
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The quality of relay protection data is an important basis for supporting the professional application of relay protection, and the integrity of the professional data of relay protection is an important part of the relay protection data quality. This paper proposes a method for checking the integrity of relay protection data. The method first obtains the data attributes required for professional applications in relay protection, and then uses the rough set reduction method to determine the relationship between the data attributes, that is, whether there is a corresponding relationship between attributes as condition attribute and the decision attribute, and the decision attribute can be removed from the integrity check attribute set as needed. Aiming at the complex correlation between different attributes, an optimization model is established to comprehensively eliminate redundant attributes, so that the attributes covered in the integrity check attribute set are necessary attributes. According to the obtained integrity check attribute set, integrity check is performed on the accessed data to verify the integrity of the data.

articleTitle: A Two-stage Optimal Scheduling Approach for Networked Distributed Energy Resources in Power Distribution Systems
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: With the increasing penetration of distributed energy resources (DERs) and new emerging market entities, e.g., DERs aggregators, the traditional scheduling strategy is no longer applicable, as it can neither deal with the “curse of dimensionality” problem nor consider the aggregators’ interests.
