To this end, this paper proposes a two-stage optimal approach for scheduling the massive networked DERs. In stage 1, the massive DERs are firstly aggregated by the aggregators and then the distribution system operator (DSO) further aggregates the aggregators’ power variation ranges connected at the same bus, from which the “curse of dimensionality” problem can be solved. In stage 2, based on the stage 1 DSO’s dispatch setpoints to the aggregated aggregators, a Nash bargaining-based P2P trading model is established for maximizing aggregators’ profits. To protect the privacy of aggregators, the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM)-based algorithm is proposed to facilitate the peer-to-peer (P2P) trading among aggregators and track the DSO’s dispatch. To verify the correctness and effectiveness, the proposed strategy is tested on modified IEEE-33 buses with massive DERs.

articleTitle: Hybrids of LiMn2O4 nanoparticles anchored among carbon nanotubes as efficient cathode material for high-performance rechargeable hybrid aqueous batteries
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: A binary LiMn2O4/carbon nanotubes (LMO/CNT) composite is effectively synthesized through a simplistic hydrothermal method. Morphologies, structures and the electrochemical properties of LMO/CNT hybrid as cathode material are detailed studied in rechargeable hybrid aqueous batteries (ReHABs). The about 300 nm LiMn2O4 particles with spheroid morphology are anchored among the wrinkled and twisted carbon nanotubes. The LMO/CNT electrode in ReHAB displays better rate capability and excellent cyclability than pristine LMO electrode. The reversible discharge capacities of LMO/CNT electrode in ReHAB are 128.5 mAh/g, 125.3 mAh/g, 118.1 mAh/g, 107.1 mAh/g, 92.5 mAh/g and 71.9 mAh/g at the current density of 0.2 C, 0.5 C, 1.0 C, 2.0 C, 5.0 C and 10.0 C, respectively. The strengthened electrochemical properties are profited from the energetic impacts of carbon nanotubes, which knit an interlaced electrical conductive network, insuring the ceaseless electron pathway in solid material and restraining the volumetric change of LiMn2O4 particles during the lithium ions intercalation and deintercalation.

articleTitle: A Novel sEMG Denoising Method Based on Multi-Level Improved Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Surface EMG plays an important role in muscle health assessment and motion recognition. However, the collected EMG signals are often polluted by different noises. The superposition of these different components leads to the deviation in the understanding of the nature of EMG signals. Therefore, this paper proposes a Multi-Level Improved Wavelet Transform method to remove other noises from raw sEMG signals. The method firstly analyzed the components of the original signal. Then, decomposed the source signal by improved wavelet transform with multi-level threshold, and removed the noise components by threshold judgment. Finally, the signal was reconstructed to obtain the pure sEMG signal. Experimental results show that this method is superior to traditional methods such as wavelet transform, digital filter, and moving average filter. It lays a foundation for signal feature extraction, recognition, and wearable device control.

articleTitle: Correlation Analysis of Wind Generator Wide Band Oscillation modes and influencing factors based on FP-Growth Method
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: A FP-growth based correlation analysis method for wind generator oscillation modes and influencing factors is proposed in this paper. Primarily, by segmenting the collected data of wind turbine output power, voltage and wind speed, a method for mining and identifying oscillation modes based on Pony algorithm is proposed. Then by clustering the mean of wind speed and voltage based on spectral clustering algorithm, an association rule between wind speed - voltage clustering and oscillation modes based on FP - growth algorithm is proposed. Finally, based on the analysis of the results of association rule, an oscillation mode prediction method based on wind speed-voltage clustering is proposed. The proposed method in this paper can realize the oscillation mode identification of the unit based on the big data of wind turbine operation, which is of certain significance for improving the operation of wind turbine.

articleTitle: Collaborative Modeling Power Smart IoT Entity Services based on Extended Timed Automata
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Internet of Things has made great progress and evolved into a smart IoT system in power grid field. There are usually massive terminal entities in a power smart IoT system and these terminal entities has a great impact on the performance of a power smart IoT system. In order to improve the stability and feasibility of a power smart IoT system, the behaviour influence and service pattern of power smart IoT entities should be deeply analyzed and verified before they are put into use. This paper summarizes three types of service pattern about the power smart IoT entities and establishes the models of single atomic services and collaborative atomic service of power smart IoT entities respectively with the theory of extended timed automat. Finally, the practicality of the established models is verified by a case of an indoor smart substation temperature automatic control system and the UPPAAL tool.

articleTitle: Design of power control system of thermal power unit based on Internal Model Control
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: In order to better adapt to the generation requirements, it is necessary to optimize the power control system of the unit. Internal model control (IMC) is introduced into the power control system of thermal power unit and a new system is formed by adding built-in model into the original system. At the same time, the controller suitable for the system is designed to control the primary frequency modulation characteristics and AGC variable load performance of the control system under the condition of the change of the flow coefficient of the local valve of the turbine. The simulation results show that, after the introduction of internal model control, not only the new power control system has a significant improvement in many indicators, but also the frequency modulation process is not easy to appear "underintegration" and "overintegration" phenomenon. Therefore, the introduction of internal model control improves the coordination of thermal power unit source network.

articleTitle: An Identification Method of Switchgear Insulation Defect Based on Partial discharge Statistical Characteristics and the Radar Map
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Switchgear is the key equipment in the distribution network, and fast and efficient accurate identification of partial discharge for switchgear is critical for the early warning of insulation failure. In this paper, a feature characteristics extraction and a simple and intuitive identification method is proposed by experimentally simulating the partial discharges of typical defects of switchgear equipment. Firstly, different discharge models are built in the laboratory and UHF sensors are used to obtain the partial discharge signals. Subsequently, 6 partial discharge statistical feature characteristics are calculated by analyzing the characteristics of the 3-dimensional partial discharge patterns. The feasibility of defect type identification based on 6 feature characteristics is verified by using K-means clustering. On this basis, the 6 partial discharge statistical feature characteristics of different defects are plotted in the radar map, and different typical defects are identified visually and clearly by the shape and area presented by the feature characteristics in the radar map. The results show that the selected statistical features: the maximum magnitude of discharge, the average magnitude of discharge, the total amount of discharge magnitude, the total number of discharge, the ratio of positive and negative half-period total discharge magnitude and the mean value of the standard deviation of discharge magnitude can well reflect the discharge characteristics of different defects, and the accurate identification of fault types can be realized by drawing the radar map of different defects' features

articleTitle: Fault location technology based on micro PMU measurement in active distribution network
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The fault location technology of distribution network is of great significance to reduce the outage time and frequency of power system and improve the reliability of power supply. The widespread application of synchronous phase measurement technology lays the foundation for the distribution network to achieve fault location. In this paper, using the electrical phase volume information obtained from PMU measurements configured only at the end of distribution lines, we propose a fast and accurate fault location algorithm based on the dichotomous search method. The fault current component at the fault point is calculated from the measured current before and after the fault at each PMU configuration node, and the fault point is searched based on the dichotomous algorithm for each line in turn, and the positive sequence voltage at each PMU configuration node is calculated based on the derivative matrix and the positive sequence component of the fault current formed during the search process, and the actual fault point is determined by the minimum deviation between measured value and calculated value. The proposed algorithm can effectively and accurately determine the exact location of the fault under the influence of noise and transition resistance, as verified by Matlab /Simulink simulation of a typical distribution network with IEEE34 nodes.

articleTitle: A calibration parameter estimation method of analog control module for nulling unit
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: With the rapid development of aerospace technology, the development requirements of spacecraft components are more and more strict, as well as the detection of multipactor effect of high-power microwave load. Nulling unit plays a key role in the nulling detection method for multipactor effect. Aiming at the problems of overwhelming calibration points and low calibration accuracy of the analog control module in the nulling unit, an interpolation algorithm based on KPLS is proposed. Firstly, the existing calibration data are projected into the kernel space, then the PLS algorithm is used for modeling, the interpolation calculation is finally done to improve the calibration efficiency and the accuracy. The effect of the method is verified through experiments.

articleTitle: Optimal Location and Capacity Planning of PV in AC/DC Distribution Network Based on Improved Particle Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Distributed generations (DG) such as photovoltaics (PV), as renewable energy sources, can be continuously obtained from nature and have the characteristics of flexible integration and environmental friendliness. The location and capacity of PV is an important part of the planning and design of AC and DC distribution network, it is related to the distribution of AC and DC distribution network voltage, and affects the stability of the entire AC and DC distribution network voltage. In this paper, firstly, a PV location and capacity optimization model is built with the goal of minimizing the annual investment cost of PV and the expected value of network loss. Then, an Immune Chaos Hybrid Particle Swarm Optimization (ICHPSO) method is adopted to solve the planning of the PV system in AC and DC distribution network. Finally, the configuration optimization method is implemented and verified with test systems. The results show that the proposed planning method realizes the improvement effect of PV on the node voltage, and the optimization algorithm used has good convergence characteristics and the ability to quickly find the global optimization. Compared with the results of deterministic analysis, the annual investment cost when considering the uncertainty of the load source is smaller, and it can better reflect the actual situation, which verifies the rationality of the planning model proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Probe into a fault cause of 220kV current transformer
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The reliability of current transformer operation is directly related to the safe and stable operation of power grid. This paper introduces a 220 kV current transformer oil level abnormal fault, in order to ensure the safe and stable operation of the power grid and to avoid the occurrence of accidents, the content of dissolved gas in insulating oil was detected for other current transformers made by the same manufacturer of fault current transformer, and abnormal conditions were found. In order to find out the cause of the fault, the fault current transformer was checked and disassembled at the factory, and several problems were found in the vacuum drying of the equipment and the primary insulation of the equipment, the partial overheat water decomposition and partial discharge occur in the operation of the equipment. With the increase of partial discharge and overheat, the insulation oil will deteriorate and a lot of gas will precipitate out. According to the reason of failure, the corresponding preventive measures are put forward.

articleTitle: Security Architecture Design of Virtual Power Plant Based on Edge Computing and Blockchain
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: With the integration of large-scale renewable energy into the grid, the power grid has increasingly higher requirements for the scale of virtual power plant (VPP) that can aggregate user-side flexible resources. However, with the increasing number of distributed energy resources (DERs) connected, the heterogeneous data generated by the terminal also increases, which poses new challenges for VPP data management in terms of real-time, stability, and security. Aiming at the difficulties of the existing VPP architecture in processing massive edge data, based on the advantages of edge computing and blockchain in edge data processing and cloud information security management, this paper proposes a VPP security architecture design method. The application applicability of edge computing, blockchain, and VPP is analyzed, the edge computing nodes (ECNs) configuration and technical architecture are introduced, and the specific services that the architecture can be applied to are explained. The encryption and verification function of the command of the cloudside collaboration and contract information is designed. This architecture can better take into account the real-time information on the edge, which is conducive to the overall scheduling of the VPP and also improves its stability and safety.

articleTitle: Two-stage Risk Control Method of the Distribution Network for Resilience Enhancement
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The development of renewable energy, such as solar energy, is of great significance to promote energy transition and the realization of carbon peak and carbon neutrality goals. From the perspective of ensuring the reliability of the renewable power system, a two-stage risk control method of distribution network for resilience enhancement is proposed. First, an operational risk qualification model considering the fault of distribution lines is built, and a risk control framework of the distribution network with preventive control and corrective control is proposed. Secondly, a demand response (DR) model of electricity users is established and the preventive control model of the distribution network with operational risk is constructed. Then, aiming at minimizing the emergency risk when fault occurs, the corrective control method of the distribution network is proposed. Finally, the modified IEEE 33-node distribution system is utilized for the case study, and the results show that the proposed two stage risk control method can effectively reduce the operating cost of the distribution network, and help to alleviate the load shedding situation when potential fault occurs.

articleTitle: Electrical properties regulation of MoS3(1-x)F3x/graphene heterojunctions by asymmetric F doping
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The interfacial bonding of MoS3(1-x)F3x/graphene heterojunctions and the effect of asymmetric F atoms doping on the electrical properties of heterojunctions were studied by using a dispersion-corrected plane wave ultrasoft pseudopotential method. Studies have shown that a stable stack structure of vdW bond can be formed between MoS2 and graphene, and F atoms can also be stably doped. Through energy band structure calculation, it is found that the coupling of MoS2 and graphene leads to the transformation of MoS2 into an n-type semiconductor, the conversion of graphene into a p-type system with a small band gap, and the F atoms further enhances the system activity. What is more, through density of states analysis, F atoms improve the contribution of Mo 4d orbital to the conduction band of the heterojunction, and it increases with the addition of concentration. These provide rational evidence for the asymmetric dopant concepts to design and fabricate MoS2-based nanoelectronics.

articleTitle: Research on Air Conditioning Load Forecasting Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: In order to solve the scheduling problem of user heating and cooling, the air conditioning load prediction model and nonlinear model of air conditioning load nonlinear model are established, so as to achieve more accurate prediction results and strengthen the collaborative optimization of integrated energy system. Then the advantages and disadvantages of traditional methods and neural network are compared, and the methods of improving prediction accuracy are analyzed.

articleTitle: Multi type sensor access method for power IOT sensing network based on edge computing
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Aiming at the problem of poor access effects of multiple types of sensors in the power Internet of Things sensor network. This paper proposes a multi-type sensor access method for power Internet of Things sensor network based on edge computing. Based on the unified sensor access model centered on the site, combined with the principle of edge computing, the streaming processing framework structure is optimized. Simplify the access steps of multi-type sensors in the power IOT sensing network, and improve the data acquisition, observation filtering and observation storage functions of multitype sensors in the power IOT sensing network, so as to improve the access effect of multi-type sensors in the power IOT sensing network. Finally, experiments show that the multi-type sensor access method of power IOT sensing network based on edge computing can have high practicability, better ensure the operation quality of power system and fully meet the research requirement.

articleTitle: Research on Fast Detection and Identification of Short Circuit Fault Based on Voltage in Multi-level Low Voltage AC System
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The existing fast or early detection and identification methods of short-circuit faults in low-voltage systems are all based on the sharp increase in current after a short-circuit to extract characteristics of faults. It has the problem of misjudgment caused by the interference of the noise of the power distribution system and the non-fault operation state such as load starting or switching. According to the characteristics that the terminal voltage of the low-voltage AC system, which is the voltage at the end of each branch, almost suddenly drops to zero when the short-circuit fault occurs, and remains near zero until the fault is eliminated, the wavelet packet detail decomposition method is introduced to extract the fault characteristics of voltage. And in order to eliminate the influence of line noise, load start, etc. on voltage signal interference, a new method for fast detection of voltage short-circuit faults is formed, which is a combination of voltage wavelet packet detail decomposition method and terminal voltage instantaneous value method. A real simulation model of single-phase short circuit fault in multi-level low voltage AC system is established. The waveforms of the faulty terminal voltage in the full phase angle range are analyzed, and the principle and technical realization of the new method for fast detection of voltage short-circuit faults are explained. In addition, disturbances such as start-up of loads of different capacities are analyzed, and the threshold value of the new method for fast detection of voltage short-circuit faults is studied. Simulation and experimental analysis not only verify the effectiveness and rapidity of the early detection of short-circuit voltage, but also ensure the reliability of the existing rapid or early detection methods of short-circuit current.

articleTitle: Current situation and Optimization Countermeasures of Shore power at inland ports in China
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The The use of shore power for inland ship berthing operation is an important means to reduce ship exhaust pollution to the environment. In recent years, the coverage rate of electric facilities at domestic river and port ports has increased significantly, but the use situation is not ideal. In order to improve the utilization rate of shore power in inland river ports, through a large number of investigations and taking typical inland river terminals as an example, three main problems affecting the use of shore power are summarized, including the construction of shore power facilities does not meet the current standards, and the lack of necessary components and ship equipment. In view of the existing problems, suggestions on the optimization of shore power use, policy supervision and incentive measures are put forward.

articleTitle: Structure and function design of power supply guarantee generator vehicle based on hydrogen fuel cell
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: In order to reduce the pollution caused by the use of traditional diesel generator vehicles in power supply guarantee, this paper put forward the application of hydrogen fuel cell in power supply guarantee, and proposed the structure and function design methods of power supply guarantee generator vehicle based on hydrogen fuel cell. The flywheel energy storage device was used as the transition power supply of the mains power and hydrogen fuel cell system, and the electric chassis vehicle was used as the backup starting power supply for hydrogen fuel cell, further improving the reliability and environmental protection of the hydrogen fuel cell generator vehicle. Through the parallel operation control of four groups of hydrogen fuel cell modules and the coordinated control of three kinds of energy storage systems, the stable operation of hydrogen fuel cell generator vehicle was realized, so that it has the functions of uninterrupted power supply and emergency power generation. A 400 kW hydrogen fuel cell generator vehicle was developed and tested. The test results showed that the vehicle can maintain stable output voltage and current when the mains power supply was interrupted and restored, realizing uninterrupted power supply to important loads.

articleTitle: Mechanical Design of a Salix Planting Vehicle
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Nowadays, land desertification has become one of the most serious ecological and environmental problems that directly threaten the survival and development of humankind. Land desertification control is not only conducive to solving environment problems, but also related to the development and progress of human society. The traditional method of planting Salix is not only inefficient, but also has a variety of problems such as high safety hazards and waste of water resources. Consequently, we have designed a Salix planting vehicle based on the water vapor planting method, which can not only realize automatic planting, but also has the advantages of simple structure and energy saving and environmental protection.

articleTitle: Research on Control Optimization of integrated intelligent energy system based on big data analysis
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: With the rapid development of China's integrated energy system, it is very important to provide better integrated energy services for energy supply service providers, enterprise users and government agencies. Therefore, in order to optimize the operation of an integrated intelligent energy system, the relationship model of cooling load, system energy consumption, controllable variables of system equipment and uncontrollable variables of environment is established, and the reliability of the model is calculated, taking the minimum system energy consumption as the optimization objective, the optimal control strategy is solved. The results show that the energy consumption of the system is significantly reduced and the effect of energy saving is achieved.

articleTitle: A method and research of elevator energy efficiency detection
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: With the continuous development of society and the continuous realization of people's better life, the elevator is more and more popular and increased, thus the energy loss brought by the elevator is also constantly increasing, causing a great degree of concern. In this paper, in order to research an effective computing analysis of elevator energy loss analysis of energy efficiency testing instruments, set its working environment and equipment related parameters, selection of typical brand model as the research object, using the elevator testing light headed for tons of km power consumption calculation principle, through to its power, power consumption, the change of the relevant data such as voltage, current curve analysis and calculation. The energy efficiency index grade of relevant stage electricity operation is obtained, which provides relevant technical reference data and theoretical analysis numerical basis for special equipment industry to formulate relevant energy saving and emission reduction.

articleTitle: A Review of Applied Research on Household Photovoltaic Power Generation Systems
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: A review of applied research conducted on aspects related to the efficiency and versatility of household photovoltaic (PV) power generation systems is presented. In photovoltaic power generation systems, the inverter is one of the core parts of the photovoltaic power generation system, and the most important technical bottleneck of the grid-connected inverter is that the interference it generates affects the normal operation of the system. In order to improve the efficiency, reliability, power density and achieve maximum power transmission of the inverter, in-depth research and optimization of the new circuit topology design, high-frequency switching technology, intelligent control technology, soft-switching technology, intelligent detection and protection, modularity, and electromagnetic compatibility of the inverter for photovoltaic power generation systems are required.

articleTitle: Applications of different nanomaterials in lithium-ion battery
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The emergence of the energy crisis leads electric vehicles into people's sight, providing a way to improve the environment and energy problems. With the support and efforts of local governments and enterprises, electric cars are now developing rapidly. However, in recent years, the increasingly mature electric vehicle technology has appeared a bottleneck - battery. The performance of electric vehicles largely depends on the properties of batteries, the high energy density and long cycle life. The lithium-ion battery can meet these requirements. It also has no memory effect and other characteristics, so researchers pay more attention to it. However, in the pursuit of the high energy lithium-ion battery, electrode and electrolyte materials limit the further improvement of the battery performances. In the researches, it was found that nanomaterials can improve the performance of lithium-ion batteries in different aspects, so they are gradually applied in lithium-ion batteries of electric vehicles. This paper introduces several nanomaterials used in different electrodes and electrolytes, compares their advantages and disadvantages, and puts forward the prospect of developing nanomaterials in lithium-ion batteries in the future.

articleTitle: Study on Microstructure and Properties of H13 Hot Working Die Steel during Tempering
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: H13 is a widely used hot working die steel. Good heat treatment process can improve its impact toughness and prolong the service life of the die. The microstructure and properties characteristic of H13 hot working die steel during quenching and tempering were studied. The results show that the microstructure of annealed H13 was better than that of rolled one. The dispersion distribution of carbides and its full dissolution during quenching significantly improved the impact toughness after tempering. The increase of tempering times and tempering temperature can significantly improve the properties of the material. After tempering for four times at 873K, the impact absorbed energy of annealed H13 was 19.8J and the hardness remained above 45HRC; the steel was tempered twice at 873K and at 833K respectively, the impact absorbed energy was 18.2J and the hardness was nearly 48 HRC. The coordination of tempering temperature and times can make the H13 hot working die obtain excellent properties.

articleTitle: SOM-based Analysis Model of Anti-Stealing Electricity
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: With the expansion of the power network, this paper proposes a power theft analysis model based on SOM for the current power theft problem in the power system. The model selects Q value, average line loss rate, standard deviation of line loss rate, line loss change trend, line loss kurtosis, and line loss skewness as model analysis indicators. According to the established model, locating the users of stealing electricity, and accurately carrying out anti-theft management, has provided great help for the line loss management in the power system.

articleTitle: Coordinated Planning of Integrated Energy Station Based on Stochastic Multi-source Uncertain Dispatch
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: With the continuous progress of new energy technology, the grid-connected capacity of stochastic energy is increasing year by year. For the distribution network with relatively less load, the grid-connected capacity of stochastic energy may exceed the load of the distribution network in this trend, which is followed by the burden of consumption of stochastic energy resources. The output of random energy is greatly affected by the environment, showing obvious uncertainty. This paper studies the uncertainty factors of the source side and load side in the operation process of the electricity-gas integrated energy system, in which the source side mainly refers to the uncertainty of distributed wind power, and the load side mainly refers to the uncertainty of several flexible loads such as transferable electric/gas load, reducible electric/gas load and convertible electric load. In the case of a high proportion of distributed wind power connected to the distribution network, the target cascade distributed optimization algorithm is used to explore the distributed coordinated optimization operation of the electricity-gas integrated distribution network, aiming at improving the economy of the operation of the two networks and promoting the consumption of renewable energy to the greatest extent on the premise of ensuring the data privacy of the distribution network and the gas distribution network.

articleTitle: Research on Construction Contents and Standards of Terminal Energy Internet Grid System
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: Energy Internet is a comprehensive system that involves many fields. It’s an important prerequisite to clarify the con-struction contents of energy internet for scientific and efficient planning. and it’s an important guarantee to build an energy internet standard system for high-quality construction. Therefore, this paper takes the regional Energy Internet as the research object, mainly analyses the construction content of the terminal energy Internet, introduces the important directions of the Energy Internet in energy production conversion, transmission and distribution, consumption and utili-zation, and energy storage optimization; establishes the terminal energy Internet construction standard framework system, and studied the deficiencies of the current standard bodies. Finally, this paper puts forward opinions on the construction of the terminal Energy Internet.

articleTitle: Research on the Active Isolated Operation Strategy of Regional Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: An energy aggregation strategy of regional integrated energy system under active isolated operation state is proposed in this paper. Through the proposed strategy, the capacity and efficiency of energy accumulation under emergency mode of all kinds of power and stockpile equipment is significantly improved. First, according to the characteristic analysis of the adjustable capacity in the area, the emergency power supply model is established. Then, the immune clonal algorithm is introduced to the model and the feasibility and effectiveness is verified by a real case. The stratgy proposed in this paper arouse the dormant resources to a great extent, which make full use of the superiority of the distributed energy storage and improve the reliability of regional power consumption. Meanwhile, it provides a new idea and lays a practical foundation for the future development of power grid.

articleTitle: A railway rail straightness detection mechanism and error analysis
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: In recent years, China's high-speed rail industry has developed rapidly. At the same time, the railroad rail manufacturing industry is also undergoing automation transformation and industrial upgrading. Straightness is an important aspect of evaluating the quality of rails. Traditional rail straightness is mainly tested manually using standard long straightedges and plug gauges. Due to the low efficiency of manual measurement and large errors, the research on automated rail straightness measurement equipment is becoming more abundant at this stage. Based on the proposed mechanism of rail straightness detection based on the cooperation of dual sensors, this paper analyzes its systematic error. It mainly includes the influence of the dimensional chain on the straightness and the influence of the included angle of the sensor mounting plate on the straightness. At the same time, the difference between the measurement method and the manual measurement method is also analyzed.

articleTitle: Distribution network cluster partition method based on multiobjective particle swarm algorithm
publicationTitle: EMIE 2022; The 2nd International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering
abstract: The large-scale grid connection of distributed power sources increases the complexity of the distribution network structure and makes the adjustment of the distribution system more complex, which brings adverse effects to the power grid. This paper mainly studies the problem of multi-objective distribution network cluster division with large-scale distributed energy. Firstly, a distribution network cluster division index is established, including modularity and active and reactive power balance indices. Then a dynamic multi-objective particle swarm algorithm is proposed to obtain the Pareto frontier of cluster division. Finally, the Max-Min method is adopted to choose a compromise solution for cluster division. The experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper can give an ideal cluster division result.
